The kind of place locals know and visitors are lucky to stumble upon.
description_zh: 大皇宮附近評分 4.9 的在地口袋名單 🌶️ ออนชอน 藏在拉差達姆能路上的粉紅小店，烤豬肉佐魚露香草醬、醃豬肉拌沙拉道道下飯，每份不到百銖卻味道夠勁，是本地人午餐衝來、外地人繞路也要來的那種老城區小館。
address: 21 Prachathipatai Rd, Khwaeng Wat Bowon Niwet, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A 93-year family recipe hiding near the Giant Swing 🍜 While tourists queue at Thipsamai around the corner, locals and savvy travelers head to MaeThum Padthai — a cozy, intimate shophouse where the owner cooks from his late mother's recipe. The crispy pad thai with tamarind sauce, plump prawns, and crushed peanuts has been called the best in Bangkok by more than a few regulars who came back six times in a row. Under 100 baht, no air con, and every bite worth it.
description_zh: 93 年的炒河粉秘方，就藏在金山寺旁 🍜 MaeThum Padthai 是本地人眼中比 Thipsamai 更值得排隊的隱藏版，老闆以母親的家傳食譜掌廚，招牌酥脆炒河粉羅望子醬汁酸甜平衡、大蝦飽滿、花生香氣撲鼻，一份不到 100 銖，逛廟途中最值得拐進去的一頓。
address: 6/3 Thanon Siri Phong, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: 101 & Co. Coffee Roastery - Coffee of Thonglor
name_zh: 101 & Co. Coffee Roastery - Coffee of Thonglor
description_en: Thonglor's most no-nonsense specialty coffee kiosk ☕ Tucked into Eight Thonglor building, 101 & Co. roasts its own beans in-house and keeps it simple — the signature 101 Coffee with house syrup is rich and smooth, and the fresh OJ with espresso shot is a must-try. No seating, pure takeaway, and exactly the kind of honest daily coffee that keeps Thonglor regulars coming back every morning.
description_zh: 通羅最實在的自家烘焙咖啡小站 ☕ 101 & Co. 藏在 Eight Thonglor 的小角落，主打「คั่วเองนักเลงพอ」自家烘焙豆，招牌 101 Coffee 濃郁滑順不帶酸、鮮榨橙汁配濃縮咖啡是通關密語，沒有座位、純粹外帶，是通羅上班族每天晨間必報到的那杯。
address: 88/36 Eight Thonglor Building Sukhumvit55 Rd, แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most Seoul-worthy hidden café ☕ Voiij is tucked away in a clean, minimalist space on Thong Lo Road — the kind of café where the owner clearly obsesses over every bean selection. The signature latte is rich and smooth, the coffee-apple juice blend is refreshingly unexpected, and the homemade carrot cake has its own loyal fanbase. Pet-friendly, free parking, and open from 8:30am. The perfect quiet escape from Thonglor's bustle.
description_zh: 通羅最有首爾感的隱藏版咖啡廳 ☕ Voiij 藏在通羅小巷的白色極簡空間裡，老闆親自挑豆、用心烘焙，招牌 Dirty 滑順不酸、蘋果咖啡清爽驚喜，手工胡蘿蔔蛋糕是常客必點，寵物友善、有停車場，像在朋友家喝咖啡一樣自在。
address: 117 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most progressive coffee bar ☕ RISE COFFEE sits in a courtyard near Marché Thonglor — no indoor fuss, just great outdoor vibes, quality specialty beans, and a creative menu with standout drinks like the Dirty Cereal Killer and Black Fizz. Passionate baristas, decent WiFi for laptop days, and even coffee beans and capsules to take home. The kind of coffee bar that doesn't need to be anything more than exactly what it is.
description_zh: 通羅最有個性的進步咖啡空間 ☕ RISE COFFEE 藏在 Marché 附近的露天中庭，招牌 Dirty Cereal Killer 與 Black Fizz 名字就夠吸引人，豆子品質講究、吧台師傅熱情分享，有 WiFi 可以工作、還賣自家豆與膠囊，是通羅咖啡族晨間的日常選擇。
address: PHHJ+FGV, Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand

description_en: From 5 cups a day in Thonglor to Bangkok's fastest-growing roastery ☕ BEANS Coffee Roasters started in this very hidden Thong Lo location three years ago — so tucked away you had to walk through an office to find it. Word spread, cups multiplied, and now there are 16 branches across the city. The coconut latte is the gateway drink, the single origins are precisely brewed, and the original Thonglor store still carries that underdog charm that started it all.
description_zh: 從通羅小巷走向全曼谷的咖啡傳奇 ☕ BEANS Coffee Roasters 三年前從通羅這個幾乎找不到入口的隱藏小店起家，每日五杯賣到十萬杯，如今已展店 16 家，椰奶拿鐵滑順入門、單品濾杯講究精準，通羅原店藏在辦公室深處，找到了反而更有成就感。
address: 386,388 แขวงพระโขนงเหนือ เขตพระโขนง Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most unapologetically cool coffee bar 🧡 LOCAL BOYS COFFEE CO. on Thonglor Soi 13 is raw, urban, and entirely its own thing — graffiti walls, neon orange-red signage, and coffee served in branded cans. The Coco Box Coffee arrives in a chocolate shell with coconut ice cream and espresso, the Neo Dirty blends yogurt, paste, and coffee shot in a way that shouldn't work but absolutely does. Right across from After You, and the most memorable 160 baht you'll spend in Thonglor.
description_zh: 通羅最有個性的街頭咖啡吧 🧡 LOCAL BOYS 以霓虹橘紅、塗鴉牆面打造反傳統咖啡空間，咖啡裝在橘色罐子裡端上桌、Coco Box Coffee 用巧克力殼盛裝椰子冰淇淋與咖啡，Neo Dirty 加了優格與奶油乳酪出乎意料地好喝，對面就是 After You，逛通羅必經之地。
address: 267, 7 Soi Thong Lo, เเขวงคลองตันเหนือ Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's best-kept coconut coffee secret 🥥 Bump Coffee Space hides in a quiet soi in Thonglor — but the coconut coffee alone is worth tracking it down. Beautiful to look at, perfectly balanced between espresso and milk, with a subtle coconut sweetness that enhances rather than overwhelms. Smooth, refreshing, and unlike any iced coffee you've had before. Bonus: they serve Thai single-origin specialty beans that remind you not to sleep on Thai coffee.
description_zh: 通羅最值得特地去找的椰子咖啡 🥥 Bump Coffee Space 藏在通羅小巷裡，招牌椰子咖啡顏值極高、咖啡與牛奶比例精準，椰香清爽不搶味、入口滑順均衡，陽光下喝格外享受，還提供泰國本土精品豆，是真正懂咖啡的人才知道的那種地方。
address: 12, 13 ถนน สุขุมวิท Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ari's most iconic specialty coffee destination ☕🌿 NANA Coffee Roasters was founded by Thailand's first-ever World Siphon Championship winner, and the coffee lives up to the legacy. Thirty-plus single-origin beans roasted in-house, served via siphon, pour-over, or espresso by baristas who know exactly what they're doing. The signature KANDA — nitro coffee meets fruit tea — is smooth and fragrant, while the Ari-exclusive Blueberry Bomb is as beautiful as it is delicious. Glass walls, warm timber, lush garden greenery, and weekend DJs. One of Bangkok's most complete café experiences.
description_zh: Ari 最值得專程造訪的精品咖啡殿堂 ☕🌿 NANA Coffee Roasters 由泰國首位世界虹吸咖啡冠軍創立，30 種以上單品豆自家烘焙、虹吸壺、手沖、濃縮應有盡有，招牌 KANDA 氮氣咖啡加果茶滑順芬芳，Ari 獨家 Blueberry Bomb 顏值破表，玻璃屋身處綠意花園，週末 DJ 接力，是 Ari 最有靈魂的咖啡地標。
address: 24, 2 Soi Ari 4, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: The most homely brunch spot in Ari 🏡 OIKOS means "home" in ancient Greek, and the Vanit Village café lives up to the name — warm Japandi interiors, soft natural light, and a menu that blends Western brunch classics with Japanese-inspired touches. The signature brunch plate, crab toast, handmade cinnamon rolls, and house-roasted Thai coffee make every visit feel like a slow, satisfying Sunday. Attentive without being intrusive — the kind of place you linger far longer than planned.
description_zh: Ari 最有家的感覺的早午餐咖啡廳 🏡 OIKOS 在希臘文裡意指「家」，藏在 Vanit Village 一樓，日北歐混搭風木質空間採光明亮、寬敞舒適，Signature Brunch 蛋培根香腸份量扎實、蟹肉吐司清爽鮮美、肉桂卷手工現烤，泰國精品咖啡自家烘焙，是 Ari 居民週末不想去遠處的那個答案。
address: 304/2 Vanit VIllage (Building C 1st floor, Room 102 Soi Ari 1, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Ari's favourite morning coffee ritual ☕ Lolā cafe sits quietly on Phahonyothin Road — a small, welcoming spot that's earned a loyal following among locals for its exceptional orange espresso and straightforward, heartfelt service. Reasonable prices, great quality, and no unnecessary fuss. The kind of café that becomes part of your daily routine before you even realise it.
description_zh: Ari 上班族每天早晨報到的咖啡小站 ☕ Lolā cafe 藏在 Phahonyothin 路上，招牌橙香濃縮咖啡清爽提神、價格親民、服務用心，是那種簡單純粹卻讓人喝完一杯還想再來的地方，上班前繞路特地來、也完全值得。
address: Vanit village, 304/1 Phahon Yothin Road, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Ari's most raw and characterful café ☕ BAY stands out immediately — weathered rust-metal exterior panels, leather scraps hanging from the windows, and metal chairs spilling out onto the Ari sidewalk in the most Bangkok way possible. Inside: a warm loft aesthetic, a rotating menu of specialty beans with barista guidance, excellent matcha cake, and a smooth transition to cocktails and DJ sets come evening. The kind of café that makes Ari feel like no other neighbourhood in the city.
description_zh: Ari 最有個性的鏽鐵街頭咖啡廳 ☕ BAY 用廢棄工廠鏽蝕金屬板打造外牆，路邊金屬椅直接架在人行道上，多款單品豆任你選、抹茶蛋糕質感細膩，白天是咖啡空間、傍晚 DJ 入場變身小酒吧，周末偶有市集，是 Ari 最不一樣的那個角落。
address: 111 ถนน Phahonyothin Soi 7, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Coffee, paint, and a Bangkok afternoon — all at once 🎨 TAIBAN (meaning "under the house") is tucked beneath a Hua Lamphong hostel in a leafy courtyard that doubles as an open-air painting studio. Order a drink, grab a canvas from 150 baht, and paint under the trees with all tools provided at no extra cost. No art skills required, no rush. Just one of Bangkok's most quietly joyful ways to spend a few hours.
description_zh: 喝咖啡、同時在路邊作畫，這就是 TAIBAN 🎨 藏在華藍蓬站旁的老宅院子裡，點杯拿鐵、買張畫布，在綠蔭下自在揮灑，畫具全包只收畫布費，不需要任何基礎，是曼谷最有藝術療癒感的咖啡廳。
address: 476/5 Thanon Rama IV, Khwaeng Rong Muang, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Step inside and forget you're in Bangkok 🍵  qraft. is the sister café of Peace Oriental Teahouse — a dark, zen three-storey space on Ari Soi 1 that feels transplanted straight from Kyoto. Japanese flour and butter croissants with fillings like miso caramel, honey-butter yuzu, and koicha cream sit behind a glass case, paired with some of the best matcha drinks in the neighbourhood. Calm, precise, and quietly exceptional.
description_zh: 踏進去就像瞬間移動到京都 🍵  qraft. 是 Peace Oriental Teahouse 的姊妹店，黑牆深木的禪意空間裡，用日本麵粉和奶油現烤可頌，味噌焦糖、蜂蜜柚子、抹茶奶霜各具個性，搭配一杯清澈抹茶，Ari 1 巷最讓人放慢腳步的地方。
address: 5, 7 Soi Ari 1, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: A new cafe experience every season 🎨 TRUST Cafe and Studio in Ari rotates its theme with each season — from tomato-land to Korean-inspired vintage to playful studio art — and every version is equally photogenic. Outdoor slides and mini basketball court, curated photo corners inside, a 50 baht entry fee that converts directly to your order, and drinks that taste as good as they look. Bring your most photogenic friend and clear your camera roll.
description_zh: 每季換主題，每次來都像新店 🎨 TRUST Cafe and Studio 藏在 Ari 巷弄裡，韓系復古混藝術工作室風格，戶外有溜滑梯和迷你籃球場，室內打卡角落多到拍不完，50 銖入場費直接折抵消費，巧克力飲品濃郁夠味、粉色蘇打清爽好看，是帶閨蜜來最值回票價的地方。
address: 23 1 Soi King Chamnan Aksorn, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Where architecture is the first thing you'll photograph 🌊 ONDA Cafe sits alongside Khao Niao Isaan restaurant in a striking L-shaped building on Ari Soi 7, designed by ASWA with a sculptural corrugated concrete facade that ripples like a wave at the back. Arched openings, a hidden private courtyard, and natural light pouring through every angle — coffee here feels like sitting inside a gallery. One of Ari's most architecturally distinctive spots.
description_zh: 建築本身就是打卡理由 🌊 ONDA Cafe 與隔壁 Khao Niao 伊善餐廳同出一轍，由 ASWA 設計事務所操刀，波浪狀預鑄混凝土外牆在 Ari 7 巷獨樹一幟，拱形窗讓光影流動，私人庭院靜謐舒適，一杯咖啡配一個不想走的午後。
address: Soi Ari Samphan 7 Alley, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: The accidental discovery that keeps bringing people back ☕ Ari Cafe & Bistro sits close to Bangkok Hospital — the kind of place you stumble into without a plan and return to three more times that week. Fried radish cake, shrimp pad thai, excellent flat white, and a banoffee cake that regulars rave about, all in a pet-friendly space with jazz music and a water feature. Affordable, warm, and quietly one of the most underrated spots in the neighbourhood.
description_zh: 曼谷醫院旁意外發現的舒適小館 ☕ Ari Cafe & Bistro 就在曼谷醫院附近，炸蘿蔔糕、蝦炒河粉、椰子汁道道親切，室內外座位各有氛圍，爵士樂輕輕流瀉、水景點綴其中，平價卻有質感，是那種誤打誤撞走進去、卻一再回頭的地方。
address: 11/20 Soi Phetchaburi 47, Lane 3, Khwaeng Bang Kapi, Khet Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10310, Thailand

description_en: The best-kept brunch secret at the end of Sukhumvit Soi 20 ☕ Bru Cafe is tucked at the bottom of a quiet soi — easy to miss, impossible to forget. Chicken avocado panini on ciabatta, perfectly poached eggs, fluffy pancakes with whipped butter, and a Vietnamese-inspired coffee with egg yolk that regulars keep reordering. Bright, relaxed, and never too crowded. The kind of café people return to every single Bangkok trip without fail.
description_zh: 素坤逸 20 巷底的全天早午餐寶藏 ☕ Bru Cafe 藏在小巷盡頭，雞肉酪梨帕尼尼、完美水波蛋、鬆厚鬆餅配打發奶油，每次來都有人多點一次，咖啡加蛋黃的越式靈感飲品是必試，有提供燕麥奶、空間明亮適合工作，是曼谷最值得特地走進去的那種小巷咖啡廳。
address: 47 Soi Sukhumvit 20, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A secret garden at the end of Sukhumvit Soi 35 🌿 Ryoku Cafe hides at a dead-end lane near EmQuartier — white walls, lush greenery, and dappled sunlight through old trees that make Bangkok's busiest district feel like a distant memory. The Japanese soufflé pancakes are some of the fluffiest outside Japan, the matcha drinks are beautifully made, and flower-petal ice cubes make every drink worth photographing. Theme changes every two months. Google 4.8 and thoroughly deserved.
description_zh: 素坤逸 35 巷底的秘密花園 🌿 Ryoku Cafe 藏在死巷盡頭，白牆綠植、陽光透過老樹灑落，舒芙蕾鬆餅入口即化、抹茶可可滑順芬芳，冰塊裡凍有花瓣的飲品顏值極高，每兩個月換一次主題裝飾，是曼谷最讓人忘記身在鬧區的咖啡廳。
address: 28 Soi Sukhumvit 35, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Australian soul meets Japanese calm, steps from Phrom Phong BTS ☕ Sarnies カフェ Sukhumvit is one of Bangkok's most genuinely peaceful café spaces — light wood, minimal decor, and a quiet upstairs zone that makes you forget the city outside. The black sesame dirty coffee and iced coconut long black are the regulars' go-to, the build-your-own Pimp My Breakfast plate is endlessly customisable, and the wood-fired donabe rice with clams is a serious surprise. A café worth making a habit of.
description_zh: 澳洲靈魂遇上日式禪意，在 Phrom Phong 落地生根 ☕ Sarnies カフェ Sukhumvit 以淺木色極簡空間打造宛若京都的靜謐氛圍，黑芝麻 Dirty Coffee、椰子長黑是招牌，Pimp My Breakfast 自組早午餐拼盤讓你每次來都不同，木桶炊飯配文蛤令人驚喜，是 Phrom Phong 最讓人想一個人待著的咖啡廳。
address: 1, 39 Soi Sukhumvit 37, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Sukhumvit Soi 2's most calming specialty coffee hideaway ☕ Zen Den Coffee House is tucked in the lobby of Lohas Residences, open from 7am with artisan coffee, freshly baked organic sourdough, and chocolate croissants that regulars say are worth the trip alone. Google 4.9, a genuinely zen atmosphere, and a pace that makes the rest of the day feel more manageable. A quiet gem in the heart of the city.
description_zh: Sukhumvit Soi 2 最安靜的精品咖啡小窩 ☕ Zen Den Coffee House 藏在 Lohas Residences 一樓，早上七點開始供應手工可頌與有機酸麵包，Iced Americano 餘韻悠長、香氣乾淨，Google 4.9 分、氛圍沉靜如名，是 Ploen Chit 一帶開始美好一天的最佳理由。
address: Lohas Residences Sukhumvit Hotel, 75 Sukhumvit 2, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Good Luck I Guess — and somehow it always delivers 🍀 GLIG CAFE is tucked in a glasshouse garden at Sukhumvit 49/13, drawing inspiration from Japanese minimalism with cream-white walls, warm wood, and four-leaf clover details throughout. The honey yuzu and matcha custard choux puffs are delicate and not overly sweet, the cold brew is clean and precise, and every corner of the garden is effortlessly photogenic. One of Bangkok's most charming little escapes.
description_zh: 「Good Luck I Guess」是店名的靈感，也是走進去後你的心情 🍀 GLIG CAFE 藏在素坤逸 49/13 巷的玻璃屋花園裡，日式極簡奶白色空間、四葉草 Logo 點綴其中，蜂蜜柚子泡芙、抹茶卡士達道道精緻不甜膩，冷萃咖啡清透乾淨，是曼谷最有好運氛圍的咖啡廳。
address: 219 ซอย สุขุมวิท 49/13 Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: No theatre, just really good coffee ☕ SINGLE LANE is tucked in a narrow soi off Sukhumvit 69 in Phra Khanong — an Australian-inspired specialty coffee shop with rotating imported beans from Sydney and Thai single-origins that serious drinkers will appreciate. The flat white is thick and smooth, the salted caramel honeycomb latte has its own fanbase, and the grilled cheese toastie is the perfect companion. Small, focused, and exactly what it sets out to be.
description_zh: 不花俏、只專心把咖啡做好 ☕ SINGLE LANE 藏在素坤逸 69 巷的 Phra Khanong 小巷裡，澳洲咖啡文化靈魂、雪梨進口豆與泰北單品豆輪番登場，Flat White 滑順厚實、鹹焦糖蜂巢拿鐵是招牌，簡約 Loft 空間小而精準，是認真喝咖啡的人才會特地找來的地方。
address: 26/9 Soi Sukhumvit 69, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: When the world's most iconic coffee equipment brand opens a café ☕ Hario Cafe brings Japan's legendary slow bar culture to Sukhumvit 33 — a pristine white space where pour-over drippers and glass servers line the shelves alongside specialty brews. The Cold Brew Fizz with yuzu ice cream and honeycomb is the must-try, the Latte on the Rock is smooth and satisfying, and the retail corner lets you take the whole experience home. A café for people who think about coffee a little more seriously than most.
description_zh: 咖啡器具界的傳奇品牌，在素坤逸開起咖啡廳 ☕ Hario Cafe 來自日本，白色極簡空間陳列各式手沖器具，Cold Brew Fizz 配柚子冰淇淋與蜂巢清爽驚喜、Latte on the Rock 醇厚過癮，想喝完順手帶走一組手沖組，是咖啡愛好者的朝聖地。
address: 29 Soi Sukhumvit 33, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The corner café that Bangkok coffee snobs keep coming back to ☕ ARTiS Coffee sits at the corner of Sukhumvit Soi 18 — roasting their own beans on-site, pulling espresso the right way, and serving flat whites that have been compared to Melbourne by regulars who know what they're talking about. Hill tribe-sourced Thai beans shine brightest in espresso format, double macchiato at 85 baht, and a fresh French croissant alongside. Indoor and outdoor seating, friendly staff who remember your order, and no compromises on quality. A genuine Bangkok classic.
description_zh: Asok 街角的自家烘豆精品咖啡 ☕ ARTiS Coffee 就在素坤逸 18 巷口，現場烘豆、雙份濃縮 85 銖、Flat White 媲美墨爾本水準，泰北山地豆最適合以濃縮形式品嚐，法式可頌、火腿蛋佐巴塔麵包都是常客必點，是在曼谷找了多年好咖啡的旅人終於說「找到了」的地方。
address: 390, 20 Soi Sukhumvit 18, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The best pit stop between Wat Pho and Wat Arun ☕ Orin Coffee Roaster lets you choose from a wide selection of single-origin beans, each brewed to order as a smooth, full-flavoured pour-over. The banana bread is warm, moist, and impossible to share, and the cakes are a solid 10/10. Strong AC, fast WiFi, and an owner who's genuinely welcoming and fluent in English. The kind of specialty coffee spot that makes old town Bangkok feel like a great neighbourhood to spend the afternoon in.
description_zh: 臥佛寺旁最值得坐下來的咖啡廳 ☕ Orin Coffee Roaster 提供琳瑯滿目的咖啡豆任你挑選，手沖咖啡口感滑順醇厚、風味層次豐富，熱香蕉麵包濕潤扎實，蛋糕更是讓人回頭，冷氣強、WiFi 快，老闆熱情好客，是逛完大皇宮或鄭王廟後最療癒的落腳處。
address: 20 Soi Tha Tian, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most serious and soulful coffee roaster ☕ Ceresia is a Thai-Venezuelan family operation on Sukhumvit 33/1 — small-batch roasting, seasonal single origins from global farms, and a flat white at 95 baht that Melbourne regulars call the best espresso in Bangkok. No WiFi by design, because the owners want you to talk about coffee, not scroll. Michelin-recognised, carrot cake is a must, and baristas who'll walk you through every bean on the rotation. The rare kind of coffee shop where the coffee is genuinely the most important thing.
description_zh: 曼谷最認真對待咖啡的家族小店 ☕ Ceresia 由泰國委內瑞拉家族創立，小批量在地烘焙、全球單品豆季節輪換，濃縮咖啡被多位老饕封為曼谷第一，Flat White 95 銖、胡蘿蔔蛋糕是必點，不提供 WiFi，店主用心陪你聊咖啡，米其林也認證的那種安靜誠摯。
address: 15, 1 Soi Sukhumvit 41, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A filter-only coffee shop that sets a personal benchmark ☕ Mother Roaster Pratu Phi sits near the Golden Mount, founded by the legendary 70-year-old "Auntie Pim" with one rule: single-origin filter coffee only. The menu is an overwhelming wall of bean choices — staff will walk you through by aroma and flavour preference before brewing your cup. Cozy, vintage, Google 4.8, and the kind of coffee experience that makes everything else feel like a compromise. Come before Wat Saket or after — either way, don't skip it.
description_zh: 只賣濾掛咖啡、卻是咖啡迷的朝聖地 ☕ Mother Roaster Pratu Phi 就在金山寺旁，由 70 歲阿姨 Pim 創立，菜單上只有單品濾掛咖啡，豆子種類多到讓你看 20 分鐘，店員先讓你聞香再幫你挑選，溫暖復古小空間、Google 4.8，是曼谷老城區最純粹的一杯。
address: 457 Maha Chai Rd, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A 70-year-old abandoned building, lovingly brought back to life ☕ SAMER Roastery Cafe on Wisut Kasat Road is a family-run labour of love — the owners hand-restored this decades-old building and turned it into one of Bangkok's most characterful café-hotel combos. House-roasted coffee, all-day breakfast, excellent croissants, strong AC, and open until 4:30am. A quiet sanctuary from the busy road outside, and one of the most thoughtfully conceived spaces near Khaosan Road.
description_zh: 70 年老建築改建的精品烘豆咖啡廳 ☕ SAMER Roastery Cafe 藏在 Wisut Kasat 路上的老城區，由家族親手修繕一棟廢棄 70 年的老宅，開到凌晨四點半、全天早午餐、自家烘焙咖啡配可頌，室內安靜舒適是鬧街外的另一個世界，是考山路一帶最有靈魂的咖啡落腳處。
address: 79/15 ถ. วิสุทธิกษัตริย์ Khwaeng Bang Khun Phrom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Brave Roasters is tucked away in a corner of Siam Discovery—a total hidden gem that every coffee lover needs to discover. Order a rich, velvety espresso and bite into a crispy croissant, watching those buttery layers melt on your tongue as the subtle bitterness of the coffee hits just right. It's literally heaven. Sit here, watch the endless stream of shoppers flow by, and steal your own little moment of peace while the aroma of coffee drifts through the air. Your whole afternoon just becomes softer, you know?
description_zh: 逛商場也能喝到曼谷最好的咖啡 ☕ Brave Roasters 藏在 Siam Discovery 三樓最深處，找到了就像挖到寶，巨大落地窗俯瞰 Siam 廣場與 BTS 軌道，招牌 Sukhumvit 冷萃帶肉桂柑橘香氣、拿鐵霜淇淋是必嚐，Flat White 媲美墨爾本水準，是購物中途最值得繞進去的精品咖啡。
address: 3rd Floor, Siam Discovery, Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's fastest-growing roastery, now inside Emsphere ☕ BEANS Coffee Roasters started as a virtually unfindable hideaway in Thonglor and has since grown to 16 locations — including this one at Emsphere. The coconut latte remains the crowd-pleaser, single-origin pour-overs are precise and well-sourced, and the setting inside Bangkok's newest lifestyle mall makes it the perfect mid-shopping coffee stop. The underdog story, now fully arrived.
description_zh: 從通羅小巷起家、如今展店 16 家的烘豆傳奇 ☕ BEANS Coffee Roasters Emsphere 分店坐落曼谷最新潮的購物中心裡，椰奶拿鐵滑順入門、單品濾掛咖啡精準講究，逛街逛累了最適合在這裡補充咖啡因，是最親近日常的精品咖啡體驗。
address: Emsphere, G floor, Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The most atmospheric café in Bangkok's Creative District ☕ a Coffee Roaster by li-bra-ry takes up an entire warehouse — Unit 6 of Warehouse 30 on Charoenkrung — with a roasting machine behind the bar that makes it the only branch in the li-bra-ry family to roast its own beans. Industrial exposed brick, art gallery energy, pandan waffles with a beautifully crisp outer layer, and a house blend available retail and wholesale. The perfect stop after wandering Warehouse 30's design stores and galleries.
description_zh: 曼谷創意區最有型的倉庫咖啡廳 ☕ a Coffee Roaster by li-bra-ry 整棟佔據 Warehouse 30 的第六號倉庫，工業風磚牆搭上現場烘豆機，自家烘焙特調豆同時零售批發，班蘭鬆餅外酥香氣迷人，逛完藝廊和選品店後最適合在這補上一杯，是 Charoenkrung 創意區最值得駐足的咖啡角落。
address: 30, a COFFEE ROASTER by li-bra-ry at Warehouse, โกดังที่ 6 Charoen Krung 30, Khwaeng Bang Rak, บางรัก, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A canal-side hideaway in the shadow of the Golden Mount ☕ Remedy Coffee Roastery sits on Soi Damrong Rak — enter from the street or walk in from the Saen Saep canal path, and settle in at the back where boats drift past and Wat Saket peeks through the trees. Dirty coffee, honey lemon mint soda, and a cherry cheesecake that regulars rave about, all at prices that feel almost too fair. A small, warm, and genuinely peaceful escape from old Bangkok's bustle. Open Friday to Wednesday, closed Thursdays.
description_zh: 金山寺旁運河邊的療癒小咖啡廳 ☕ Remedy Coffee Roastery 藏在 Damrong Rak 小巷裡，後院緊鄰運河，看船來船往、遠眺金山寺，Dirty Coffee 香醇順口、抹茶拿鐵清爽，新鮮水果起司蛋糕是必點，輕柔音樂、靜謐氛圍，是逛完老城廟宇後最需要的那個安靜角落。
address: 40 ซอย ดำรงรักษ์ Soi Ban Bat, Khwaeng Pom Prap, Khet Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: The kind of café that feels like your coolest friend's living room 🏡 POPCUP is tucked in a renovated old house on Ekkamai Soi 4 — warm wooden furniture, natural light, a tiny outdoor garden, and a Mid-Century vibe that makes every corner photo-ready. Two espresso blend choices, a Coconut Matcha Cloud that regulars reorder, and a brunch menu to match. Pet-friendly, free parking, open from 8am. One of Ekkamai's most charming new additions.
description_zh: 像在室內設計師朋友家喝咖啡 🏡 POPCUP 藏在 Ekkamai 4 巷的老宅改建空間裡，Mid-Century 復古家具、暖色木調、自然光灑落，Coconut Matcha Cloud 清爽甜美、Cappuccino 香濃扎實，小花園寵物友善，早八開門是附近上班族的晨間秘密，是 Ekkamai 最有家的感覺的咖啡廳。
address: 42 6 ซอย เอกมัย 4 Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ekkamai 12's most enchanting garden brunch café 🌿 BABYCCINO is a glasshouse café with a koi pond at the entrance, lush greenery all around, and natural light flooding every table. The concept is "simple but unique" — and the food delivers: the banoffee pie is among Bangkok's best, the Black Forest French Toast is buttery and topped with mascarpone, and the all-day brunch menu covers everything from fried chicken to kimchi quinoa bowls. Open from 8am, and worth every step down the soi.
description_zh: Ekkamai 12 巷最迷人的玻璃屋花園咖啡廳 🌿 BABYCCINO 入口有小魚池、玻璃屋引進自然光，「簡約而獨特」是它的靈魂，Banoffee Pie 被封為曼谷最好吃之一、Black Forest French Toast 外酥內軟，早午餐從早八開始，是 Ekkamai 最值得特地走進巷子的地方。
address: 53 Soi Ekkamai 12, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ekkamai's original third-wave coffee pioneer, since 2015 ☕ Kaizen Coffee was founded by three friends who fell in love with Melbourne's coffee culture, and it shows in every cup. The two-storey glasshouse building is sleek and airy, the espresso is precise and properly made, and the brunch menu is a genuine reason to visit — the beef eggs benedict at 395 baht is worth every baht, and the matcha lava cheesecake has been a signature since day one. A Bangkok coffee staple that consistently delivers.
description_zh: Ekkamai 咖啡場景的先驅者，2015 年起就是這一家 ☕ Kaizen Coffee 由三位澳洲咖啡文化愛好者創立，兩層樓玻璃屋空間明亮大器，第三波咖啡浪潮精神貫穿每一杯，Eggs Benedict 搭配牛肉份量扎實、Matcha Lava Cheesecake 是打卡必點，Nitro Cold Brew 入口順滑，是 Ekkamai 最有底氣的咖啡餐廳。
address: 888 6-7 Thanon Ekkamai, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The best mocha of your life — inside a baby store 🌟 Hoshi Cafe is tucked inside a children's and baby boutique on Ekkamai Soi 4 — and somehow that makes it even more charming. Natural light, calm atmosphere, and a coffee menu that punches well above its quiet exterior. One guest called the mocha the best they'd ever had anywhere. The dirty coffee and tiramisu cake are equally worth the visit, and the Japanese-inspired rice dishes and healthy salads make it a proper meal destination too. Family-friendly, laptop-friendly, and wonderfully unexpected.
description_zh: 嬰兒用品店裡藏著全曼谷最好喝的摩卡 ☕ Hoshi Cafe 藏在 Ekkamai 4 巷的童嬰選品店裡，陽光灑落、安靜舒適，招牌摩卡被顧客封為「此生最好喝」、Dirty Coffee 香醇、提拉米蘇蛋糕絕配，日式米食料理與健康沙拉同樣用心，親子友善、適合帶筆電工作，是 Ekkamai 最不按常理出牌的咖啡寶藏。
address: No, 8 Soi Ekkamai 4, แขวงพระโขนงเหนือ เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ekkamai's most characterful specialty coffee hideaway 🐰 Bad Habit Rabbit is tucked in Soi Ekkamai 19 — beautifully designed, quietly lush, and run by a team who clearly care about every detail. Rotating single-origin beans from around the world, an oat milk latte that regulars call the best they've ever had, and a space cool enough that the interior design alone is worth the visit. Pet-friendly, and very hard to leave.
description_zh: Ekkamai 19 巷裡最有個性的精品咖啡廳 🐰 Bad Habit Rabbit 空間設計精美獨特、綠意與靜謐並存，世界各地精選咖啡豆輪番登場，燕麥奶拿鐵滑順到讓人驚嘆，服務友善又有態度，是那種走進去就不想離開的地方。
address: 329/1 Soi Ekkamai 19, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The owner turned her ground floor into Ekkamai's warmest café 🏡 Daisie May's Home Cafe on Ekkamai Soi 22 is exactly what it sounds like — a home that became a café, and kept all the warmth. All-day homestyle breakfast, handmade desserts, good coffee, and an outdoor garden where dogs are welcome. The kind of neighbourhood spot that feels personal in the best possible way. Open Thursday to Monday, closed Wednesday.
description_zh: 老闆把自家一樓變成了全曼谷最暖的咖啡廳 🏡 Daisie May's Home Cafe 藏在 Ekkamai 22 巷，全天早午餐份量扎實像家人親手做，手工甜點現烤飄香，咖啡香醇舒適，戶外座位寵物友善，週四公休，是那種誤打誤撞走進去、卻覺得好像回到家的地方。
address: 76, 5 Soi Ekkamai 22, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Sukhumvit's most laid-back all-day escape 🌸 Lazy Daisy is tucked inside Gardina Hotel on Soi 16 — pastel interiors, sheer curtains, indoor and outdoor seating, and a concept they call the "Boozy Cafe." Coffee and brunch from 6am, cocktails and wine from 5pm. The truffle soup, mentaiko salmon pasta, and Pink Sunrise cocktail have their own fan clubs, and the seasonal decorations mean every visit feels a little different. Google 4.8, and the kind of place you show up for brunch and somehow stay until midnight.
description_zh: Asok 巷弄裡的「Boozy Cafe」 🌸 Lazy Daisy 藏在 Gardina Hotel 裡，粉嫩柔和色調、白色薄紗窗、室內外座位隨你挑，早上六點咖啡早午餐開始、下午五點搖身一變成雞尾酒酒吧，松露濃湯、明太子鮭魚義大利麵、招牌 Pink Sunrise 雞尾酒道道驚喜，是 Sukhumvit 16 最讓人想磨蹭一整天的地方。
address: Sammitr, 51 Soi Sukhumvit 16, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: Chim Chim Bangkok Restaurant & All-day Café
name_zh: Chim Chim Bangkok Restaurant & All-day Café
description_en: Bangkok's most art-filled all-day diner 🎨 Chim Chim is on the ground floor of Siam@Siam Design Hotel — high ceilings, rotating exhibitions from Thai and international artists, and a menu of colourful, generously portioned comfort food designed for sharing. Coffee from Roots, tea from Monsoon Tea, handmade pizza, and a Thailand Lime Highball that keeps regulars coming back. Ranked top 5 in Bangkok on TripAdvisor, with staff who feel like the reason people actually return. Open from breakfast through to midnight.
description_zh: Siam 藝術區最有靈魂的全天餐廳 🎨 Chim Chim 坐落 Siam@Siam 設計飯店一樓，挑高空間掛滿泰國藝術家輪展作品，家常料理融入創意巧思、份量豐盛適合分享，咖啡來自 Roots、茶來自 Monsoon Tea，TripAdvisor 曼谷前 5 名、服務友善如家人，是從早餐到深夜都讓人流連忘返的地方。
address: 865 Rama I Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Hong Kong's Michelin-recommended coffee brand, now in Langsuan ☕ The Coffee Academics brings its signature dark-tiled, caffeine-molecule aesthetic to Velaa Sindhorn Village — a spacious, masculine-chic space that's as much a design destination as a coffee one. Four natural sweeteners (agave, Okinawan red sugar, palm sugar, and Manuka honey) give every cup a uniquely layered sweetness, and the slow hand drip is the purest way to appreciate the premium beans. Steps from Lumphini Park, and worth every baht.
description_zh: 香港米其林咖啡品牌在 Langsuan 落地生根 ☕ The Coffee Academics 坐落 Velaa Sindhorn Village，黑色馬賽克吧台致敬香港地鐵、咖啡因分子幾何 Logo 點綴空間，四種天然甜味劑讓每杯咖啡層次更豐富，手沖、濃縮、冰咖啡任你選，就在倫披尼公園旁，是 Langsuan 最有格調的咖啡歇腳處。
address: Velaa Sindhorn Village Langsuan, 87 ซ.หลังสวน แขวงลุมพินี เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330, Thailand

description_en: A Sicilian escape hidden in Soi Somkid 🍋 Dolcetto is tucked in one of Bangkok's most charming residential lanes near Chit Lom — lemon trees, earthy terracotta tones, and an outdoor terrace that genuinely transports you to the Amalfi Coast. The spaghetti bottarga is a standout, the pistachio tart is a must, and the Italian-roasted espresso is the real deal. One of Bangkok's most convincing little pieces of Southern Italy.
description_zh: Soi Somkid 的南義海岸秘境 🍋 Dolcetto 藏在 Chit Lom 附近的精緻小巷，檸檬樹、磚牆露台、地中海藍白色調，義大利腔調濃郁不造作，墨魚義大利麵、烤牛肉球、開心果塔道道道地，在陽光下啜一杯義式濃縮，彷彿在西西里島度假。
address: 16, 18 Soi Somkid, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A roastery hiding in Bangkok's leafiest lane 🌲 Sarnies Roastery on Soi Tonson is named after the pine trees lining the street — and the pinewood interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and lush greenery make it feel exactly like that. Watch the roasting happen right in front of you, pick from single-origin Thai beans or fan-favourite blends like the bold Mr. Darkside or the fruity Smooth Criminal. All-day brunch, coffee equipment to take home, open from 7:30am, and pets very much welcome. The most relaxed member of the Sarnies family.
description_zh: 走進松樹巷弄，像是誤入咖啡人的後花園 🌲 Sarnies Roastery 藏在 Ploenchit 旁的 Soi Tonson，落地窗引進綠意、松木裝潢致敬巷名「ต้นสน」，現場烘豆機就擺在你面前轉，Mr. Darkside 濃郁、Smooth Criminal 果香清爽，早上七點半開門，寵物友善，是 Sarnies 家族最療癒的一個分店。
address: 34, 1 Soi Ton Son, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: MUJI's first food and coffee corner in Thailand ☕ Tucked inside the 1,800sqm concept flagship on the 7th floor of Central Chidlom, MUJI Coffee is Thailand's first MUJI to serve food — matcha drinks from 60 baht, Hokkaido milk sugar buns at 39 baht, fresh daily onigiri and bento boxes. Minimal wood interiors, calm atmosphere, and everything exactly as you'd expect from MUJI. The perfect pit stop mid-shopping, with no excuses to rush.
description_zh: 逛 MUJI 逛累了，就在這裡坐下來 ☕ MUJI Coffee 藏在 Central Chidlom 七樓的 1800 坪概念旗艦店裡，泰國第一家有餐飲的 MUJI，抹茶飲品從 60 銖起、北海道牛奶糖麵包 39 銖、現製便當與飯糰一應俱全，極簡木質空間配一杯咖啡，購物之餘最舒適的放鬆角落。
address: 6th floor Central Chidlom, 1027 Thanon Phloen Chit, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A New York diner hiding in the heart of Chidlom 🍔 Smith & Co. is on the ground floor of The Mercury Ville, steps from BTS Chidlom — industrial meets warm wood in a space that channels old-school NYC diner energy. The smash burger is crispy and juicy, the BBQ ribs melt-in-your-mouth sweet and smoky, and the truffle pasta is a crowd favourite. Generous portions perfect for sharing, Google 4.6, and a solid go-to every time you're in the area.
description_zh: Chidlom BTS 旁的紐約復古餐廳 🍔 Smith & Co. 藏在 Mercury Ville 一樓，工業風與木質暖色交織成老派紐約小餐館的氛圍，Smash Burger 脆皮多汁、BBQ 肋排甜辣夠力、松露奶油義大利麵令人念念不忘，份量大方適合朋友共享，Google 4.6 分，是 Chidlom 逛街後最值得坐下來犒賞自己的地方。
address: 1st floor, The Mercury Ville Chidlom, 540 Thanon Phloen Chit, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A century-old Thai pavilion hiding in the middle of Chidlom ☕ Samantao Heritage Coffee sits inside Nai Lert Park Heritage Home — a teak wooden pavilion built over a lily pond, surrounded by ancient trees and birdsong, just minutes from BTS Phloen Chit. The signature Heritage Hot Coffee with a sliver of butter is rich and unlike anything else, the pandan custard steamed buns are pillowy and fragrant, and feeding the catfish costs 20 baht and never gets old. One of the most magical breakfast spots in Bangkok — and one of the easiest to forget exists.
description_zh: 鬧市裡的百年泰式時光機 ☕ Samantao Heritage Coffee 藏在 Nai Lert Park 百年老宅裡，木造涼亭架在荷花池上，古樹遮天、鳥聲輕鳴，招牌奶油咖啡加了一片奶油在濃縮咖啡裡醇厚迷人，班蘭卡士達蒸麵包軟嫩香濃，還能花 20 銖餵鯰魚，Chidlom 最讓人忘記身在曼谷的清晨。
address: 4 ซอย สมคิด Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: CNN's 4th best fresh market in the world — and Gordon Ramsay agrees 🥭 Or Tor Kor Market sits right across from Chatuchak at MRT Kamphaeng Phet, and it's unlike any other market in Bangkok — immaculate, organized by product type, and stocked with the finest produce sourced from across the country. Perfect mangosteens, durian with no compromises, freshly steamed buns, and a food court that rewards every appetite. Pricier than street markets, and worth every baht.
description_zh: CNN 評選全球第四大生鮮市場，Gordon Ramsay 也來朝聖 🥭 Or Tor Kor 就在 Chatuchak 對面的 Kamphaeng Phet MRT 旁，乾淨明亮、井然有序，全泰國最頂級的熱帶水果、新鮮海鮮、有機蔬菜匯聚於此，椰汁糕、椰奶糯米飯、泰式甜點一字排開，比普通市場貴一點，但每一口都值得。
address: 101 Thanon Yan Phahon Yothin, Khwaeng Chatuchak, Khet Chatuchak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10900, Thailand

description_en: Surawong's best-kept rooftop secret 🌟 Starlight Rooftop Bar sits atop Mercure Bangkok Surawong — a relaxed, star-themed sky bar where the planet-inspired cocktails (Neptune, Uranus, Jupiter) are as photogenic as the city views below. Happy hour runs 5–8pm with buy-one-get-one drinks, free-flow packages available, DJ sets that don't overpower conversation, and staff who reviewers consistently name by name. Still an insider tip — not crowded, not pretentious, and open until 1am.
description_zh: 矽隆街邊最低調的星空酒吧 🌟 Starlight Rooftop Bar 藏在 Mercure Bangkok Surawong 頂樓，以行星為主題的雞尾酒 Neptune、Uranus、Jupiter 顏值極高，Happy Hour 5–8 點買一送一，DJ 音樂輕盈不吵鬧，服務親切有名、開到凌晨一點，是還沒被人潮湧入的 Surawong 秘密天台。
address: R Floor, 222 Surawong Rd, Khwaeng Si Phraya, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Sukhumvit's most complete 360° rooftop experience 🌆 Octave spans three floors of the Bangkok Marriott Hotel Sukhumvit — from a laid-back lounge on the 45th to a fully open-air bar deck on the 49th, where the Bangkok skyline wraps around you in every direction. The Bangkok 57 cocktail is the signature, the Asian tapas hold their own, and the DJ sets after sunset elevate the whole night. One of the most impressive rooftop setups in the city — reserve ahead or arrive early.
description_zh: 素坤逸最完整的 360 度天空體驗 🌆 Octave Rooftop 坐落 Bangkok Marriott Sukhumvit 45 至 49 樓，三層樓各有氛圍，最頂樓露天吧台讓你站在曼谷天際線正中央，招牌雞尾酒 Bangkok 57 是必點，日落後 DJ 進場、泰式 Tapas 下酒，是通羅一帶最壯觀的入夜儀式。
address: 2 ซอย, Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The highest rooftop bar in Bangkok — and all of Thailand 🌆 Sky Beach sits on the 78th floor of The Standard Bangkok Mahanakhon, 310 metres above the city. Walk on the glass floor, look straight down over Bangkok, then settle into a sun lounger with a cocktail crafted by award-winning mixologist Milk Thanaworachayakit. Retro-tropical yellow design, 360-degree views stretching to the horizon, live DJs after sunset, and a vibe that manages to be both thrilling and laid-back. Arrive at 5:30pm for the golden hour — you won't regret it.
description_zh: 全曼谷、全泰國最高的屋頂酒吧 🌆 Sky Beach 坐落 MahaNakhon 大廈 78 樓，310 公尺高的玻璃地板讓你直視腳下的曼谷，360 度天際線無死角，黃色熱帶復古設計、曼谷最受矚目調酒師打造的雞尾酒單，日落時分是魔法時刻、入夜 DJ 接力，一生必來一次的曼谷夜晚。
address: 78th Floor, The Standard, Bangkok Mahanakhon, 114 Thanon Naradhiwat Rajanagarindra, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: The cocktail bar that feels like floating in space 🌌 Gaze Cocktail Bar is tucked in a Thonglor soi — step inside and you're greeted by a star-lit ceiling and galaxy projections that make the rest of the city disappear entirely. The cocktail menu has hidden secrets to discover, mixologists who know their craft and tailor recommendations to your taste, and a low-key luxurious vibe that's equally suited to a date or a group night out. DJ sets Thursday to Saturday, Google 4.9, and the kind of bar that becomes someone's new favourite on the first visit.
description_zh: 通羅最像置身宇宙的調酒吧 🌌 Gaze Cocktail Bar 藏在通羅小巷，星空天花板與銀河投影讓你彷彿漂浮在太空中，調酒師以泰式風味融入經典基酒、菜單藏有隱藏彩蛋等你發現，服務親切細心、木四六週有 DJ，Google 4.9 分，是通羅最值得坐到深夜的那間。
address: 10 Thong Lo Road, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A 91-year-old fish sauce factory, reborn as Bangkok's most soulful riverside café 🏚️ My Grandparent's House on the Thonburi bank of the Chao Phraya was lovingly restored by the fourth generation of the Thungsombat family — vintage wooden armchairs, lace runners, heirlooms from every era, and river views through classic wooden shutters. Coffee, Thai iced tea, and simple snacks served in a space that feels more like visiting a beloved relative than going to a café. One of Bangkok's most quietly precious places.
description_zh: 91 年老魚醬廠，現在是昭披耶河邊最溫柔的咖啡廳 🏚️ My Grandparent's House 由 Thungsombat 家族第四代親手修復，古董傢俱、蕾絲桌巾、家族老照片讓時光靜靜停留，透過老木窗俯瞰昭披耶河，一杯泰式冰茶配上點心，是比任何博物館都更有溫度的老曼谷時光。
address: 253 Soi Somdet Chao Phraya 3, Khwaeng Somdet Chao Phraya, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most underrated Japanese all-you-can-eat gem 🍣 Aroi Sushi on New Petchburi Road is the buffet that regulars don't want everyone to know about — 70+ menu items from 799 baht, with thick-cut salmon belly, fresh oysters, wagyu sushi, and generously portioned sashimi that rival restaurants twice the price. Order via QR code, food arrives fast, and the ice cream is included. Arrive by 11am on weekdays or expect a queue. Quietly one of Bangkok's best-value Japanese experiences.
description_zh: 曼谷日式吃到飽的隱藏版王者 🍣 Aroi Sushi 藏在 New Petchburi 路上，799 銖不限時，超過 70 種菜單任你點，鮭魚腹肉厚切入口即化、生蠔鮮甜飽滿、和牛壽司是常客必點，份量大方、新鮮度有口皆碑，比同等級日料餐廳便宜一半，連日本人也說值得。
address: 40 Soi New Phetchaburi, เเขวงบางกะปิ Khet Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10310, Thailand

description_en: Four Michelin Bib Gourmands and Thailand's Best Young Chef behind the stove 🦀 Yoong Khao Hom brings a two-decade-old Koh Samui family recipe to Bangkok, with Chef Aom — winner of the MICHELIN Guide Young Chef Award — adding her own creative touch. Shrimp paste and curry paste flown fresh from the island, standout crab curry, fried oyster with taro, and coconut dumplings for dessert that regulars order every single time. The most refined Southern Thai dining experience in the city, without losing any of its soul.
description_zh: 四年米其林 Bib Gourmand、由泰國最佳年輕主廚掌廚的南部泰菜 🦀 Yoong Khao Hom 由米其林年輕主廚獎得主 Aom 操刀，蝦醬與咖哩醬直送自蘇梅島，鮮蟹咖哩、炸蠔芋頭、椰奶湯圓道道道地，是曼谷最精緻卻最有家常靈魂的南部料理體驗。
address: 355 โครงการ แอมพาร์ค ห้องเลขที่ บี 101 ถนนเจริญเมือง, วังใหม่, เขตปทุมวัน Bangkok 10330, Thailand

name_en: Penlaos Rama 3 - เป็นลาว พระราม 3
name_zh: Penlaos Rama 3 - เป็นลาว พระราม 3
description_en: Michelin Bib Gourmand Isaan cooking — no MSG, all flavour 🌶️ Penlaos began in Khao Yai and has since earned a loyal following across Bangkok with its honest, clean northeastern Thai recipes. The som tam is punchy and properly sour, the grilled pork neck is tender with the right char, and the larb is fragrant with fresh herbs throughout. No MSG, no shortcuts, and a Michelin Bib Gourmand that says everything you need to know. One of Rama 3's best reasons to make the trip.
description_zh: 不加味精的道地伊善料理，從考艾山到曼谷 🌶️ เป็นลาว 起源自考艾、連續榮獲米其林 Bib Gourmand 加持，青木瓜沙拉酸辣夠勁、烤豬頸肉焦香軟嫩、拉布肉末鮮香帶草本氣息，全程不加味精、食材新鮮，是 Rama 3 一帶最讓人一試就愛上的東北泰菜。
address: 662 69-70 Thanon Rama III, Khwaeng Bang Phong Phang, Khet Yan Nawa, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Hidden inside Siam Paragon — Bangkok's most exciting new spirits bar 🥃 BlueMoon.bkk on the 4th floor of EATELIER stocks gins and whiskies rarely seen elsewhere in Thailand, with bartenders who genuinely love what they do and guide you through every pour with enthusiasm. The corned beef fried rice is a sleeper hit, and the Happy Hour 2-for-1 deal has a way of turning one drink into a very long, very good evening.
description_zh: Siam Paragon 裡藏著曼谷最有深度的洋酒殿堂 🥃 BlueMoon.bkk 在 EATELIER 四樓，精選泰國市面少見的琴酒與威士忌，調酒師親切又懂酒、推薦起來讓人捨不得離開，招牌玉米牛肉炒飯鮮香夠味，Happy Hour 買二送一，一杯變成不知道第幾杯。
address: 4th floor Eatelier zone, Siam Paragon, แขวงปทุมวัน เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most romantic riverside jazz rooftop 🎷 Three Sixty Lounge sits on the 32nd floor of Millennium Hilton, with a futuristic glass cupola offering full 360° views of the Chao Phraya River — and live jazz every single night. Less crowded than the famous Sky Bar, more atmospheric than most hotel rooftops, and genuinely special. Take the free shuttle boat from BTS Saphan Taksin, arrive by 5:30pm for the sunset, and let the river lights and jazz do the rest. One of Bangkok's most underrated nights out.
description_zh: 昭披耶河上最浪漫的爵士天台 🎷 Three Sixty Lounge 坐落 Millennium Hilton 32 樓，飛碟造型圓頂室內Jazz Lounge 搭配河上夜景，每晚現場爵士樂演奏、雞尾酒杯倒映河光，比 Sky Bar 少人、比 Octave 更有靈魂，從 Saphan Taksin BTS 免費渡船即達，是曼谷最值得特地慶祝的河邊夜晚。
address: 123 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Sukhumvit 11's most lively open-air Thai dining spot 🌴 Moom Muum Park is a sprawling outdoor restaurant cooled by industrial fans, with a menu that covers all the Thai classics done properly — Tom Yum that regulars call the best in Thailand, generous Pad Thai, fresh seafood, and cocktails that keep the evening going. Live music, friendly staff, and a vibe that makes it impossible to leave early. Google 4.8, affordable, and open late. The perfect communal dinner spot in the Nana area.
description_zh: 素坤逸 11 巷最歡樂的露天泰菜聚集地 🌴 Moom Muum Park 戶外空間寬敞涼爽、工業風電扇輕輕搖，Tom Yum 鮮辣被封為泰國最好喝、Pad Thai 份量大方，現場音樂助興、調酒選擇多，服務親切又有活力，Google 4.8 分，是 Nana 一帶最讓人想流連忘返的夜晚聚餐地。
address: 20 Soi Sukhumvit 11, Khwaeng Khlong Toei Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Asoke's most creative and understated Thai restaurant 🌿 Madam Saranair on Sukhumvit 21 looks unassuming from the outside, but the food is anything but — the tamarind deep-fried prawns, pomelo shrimp salad, and crab curry all come with a creative twist that earns repeat visits. One reviewer came back the very next evening. Owner Alon is often on the floor, warm and attentive. Ranked #287 out of 12,000+ Bangkok restaurants on TripAdvisor, and very much deserving of a reservation.
description_zh: Asoke 最有創意的正統泰菜餐廳 🌿 Madam Saranair 藏在素坤逸 21 巷，外表低調、料理卻讓人回頭，泰式羅望子醬炸蝦、柚子鮮蝦沙拉、蟹肉咖哩道道有驚喜，有人第一晚吃完隔晚再去，老闆 Alon 親切招呼，是 Asoke 一帶最值得特地訂位的泰菜。
address: 139/1 Soi Sukhumvit 21 (Asoke Soi 1 sub-district, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Twenty years of Thai excellence, reimagined for 2026 🪷 Kinnaree by Vanessa WU has been welcoming diners on Sukhumvit Soi 8 since 2006, and has recently evolved into a contemporary Thai cuisine destination that blends timeless recipes with modern creative flair. The crab cakes are legendary, the tamarind prawns are boldly spiced, and the pomelo salad is what keeps regulars coming back. Garden seating with warm lighting, just 200 meters from BTS Nana — and one of the most romantically set Thai restaurants in the area.
description_zh: 20 年老字號泰菜，2026 年全面升級蛻變 🪷 Kinnaree by Vanessa WU 自 2006 年在素坤逸 8 巷深耕，以當代泰式料理融合傳統精髓，蟹肉煎餅鮮味十足、羅望子鮮蝦辣而開胃、柚子沙拉清爽層次豐富，花園庭院燈光浪漫，是 Nana 一帶最適合慶祝特殊場合的精緻泰菜。
address: 43 Soi Sukhumvit 8, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The beloved Chiang Mai pasta bar, now in Saladaeng 🍝 Pasta Ama's Bangkok outpost is tucked on the second floor of Baan K Residence on Sathon Soi 2 — homemade fresh pasta crafted daily, with a springy texture that earns repeat visits. The spaghetti with clams in chilli paste is the standout, blending Italian technique with bold Thai flavours. Starting at 159 baht, cozy apartment-kitchen vibes, and just a short walk from BTS Saladaeng. The kind of neighbourhood gem that office workers quietly keep to themselves.
description_zh: 清邁手工義大利麵名店在 Saladaeng 開了分店 🍝 Pasta Ama 藏在 Sathon 2 巷的公寓二樓，每日新鮮手製麵條彈牙Q滑，辣椒醬蛤蜊義大利麵是曼谷評價最高之一，泰式融合風味與義式靈魂完美結合，一盤 159 銖起，BTS Saladaeng 步行可達，是矽隆上班族午餐的最佳秘密。
address: บ้านเค เรสซิเดนซ์, 12/1 ชั้นที่ 2 Soi Sathon 2, Si Lom, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Ari's most stylish take on Isan cuisine 🌶️ Do Nūa on the 3rd floor of La Villa brings a "Glamorous Isan" concept to the neighbourhood — modern industrial-chic space with warm red tones, woven lamps, and a bold idea: pairing northeastern Thai food with wine. Som tam, spicy salads, grilled pork neck, and fried dishes all served with real Isan punch in a photogenic, share-everything setting. Right at BTS Ari, attentive staff, and the most elevated papaya salad experience in the area.
description_zh: Ari 最時髦的「Glamorous Isan」伊善料理 🌶️ Do Nūa 藏在 La Villa 三樓，紅色調現代工業風空間，大膽將伊善料理配葡萄酒，青木瓜沙拉、烤豬頸肉、辣味沙拉鮮香夠辣，擺盤精緻好拍，氣氛輕鬆友善，是 Ari BTS 旁吃東北泰菜最有型的選擇。
address: 3rd Floor, 356 Phahon Yothin Road, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Hat Yai's legendary dim sum, reimagined in an Ari century-old house 🥟 Kopihub Prime brings the famous Chonburi dim sum tradition to a stunning two-storey Thai-Chinese wooden heritage home on Ari Soi 2. The design is dramatic — traditional meets contemporary, completely photogenic from every angle. The signature Kopihub Prime Box reinterprets dim sum as omakase: white har gow replaces sushi rice, topped with truffle, sweet shrimp, crab leg, and A5 wagyu — exclusive to this branch. Regular dim sum from just 25 baht, open daily, Google 4.8. Ari's most beautiful place to linger over tea.
description_zh: 從泰南傳說到 Ari 巷弄的飲茶殿堂 🥟 Kopihub Prime 將合艾百年飲茶文化搬進 Ari 2 巷百年老泰宅，泰中古典融合現代設計、兩層木造空間美得像打卡場景，招牌 Prime Box 以白蝦餃替代壽司米飯、頂上松露鮮蝦蟹腳驚喜十足，普通蒸籠最低 25 銖起，Google 4.8 分，是 Ari 最值得特地坐下來喝一壺茶的地方。
address: 33 Soi Ari 2, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Healthy food that actually tastes incredible 🥦 O'ganic Concept on Ari Samphan Soi 1 sources vegetables directly from its own organic farm — no additives, no antibiotics, no artificial flavourings, and coconut sugar instead of refined sugar throughout. Chef O's menu spans kale salads, spicy pomelo prawns, riceberry bowls, and mango sticky rice, all prepared with real nutritional care. Google 4.8, open from 8am, and the kind of restaurant that converts people who never thought they'd enjoy health food.
description_zh: 吃得健康也可以吃得好吃 🥦 O'ganic Concept 藏在 Ari Samphan 1 巷，蔬菜直送自自家有機農場，椰糖替代白糖、抗生素自由肉品，羽衣甘藍沙拉、Riceberry 飯、芒果糯米飯道道用心，連不愛健康食物的人也說驚喜，Google 4.8、早上八點開門，是 Ari 最讓人良心無罪的一頓飯。
address: 68/1 Soi Ari Samphan 1, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: Vela Bhirom Restaurant - ร้านอาหารเวฬาภิรมย์
name_zh: Vela Bhirom Restaurant - ร้านอาหารเวฬาภิรมย์
description_en: A hidden Thai fine dining garden in the heart of Sathorn 🌿 Vela Bhirom — meaning "a time of joy" — is tucked inside Villa Deva Resort on Sathon Soi 1, surrounded by a pool and lush greenery that makes the city feel very far away. Authentic Thai fine dining by Chefs Kung and Baitong, with beautifully plated dishes like watermelon with sun-dried fish caviar and pomelo prawn salad that set the tone for the whole meal. Google 4.8, attentive service, and wine available outside. One of Bangkok's most serene and underrated Thai dining experiences.
description_zh: Sathorn 1 巷的秘密泰菜花園 🌿 เวฬาภิรมย์ 意為「快樂時光」，藏在 Villa Deva Resort 裡，泳池環繞、綠意靜謐，Fine Dining 級別的泰菜由主廚 Kung 與 Baitong 精心詮釋，西瓜乾魚魚子醬、柚子鮮蝦沙拉道道精緻優雅，Google 4.8 分，是 Sathorn 最讓人忘記身在城市的精緻泰菜體驗。
address: 88 Soi Sathon 1, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Nonna's recipes from Molfetta, hidden in a Sathorn soi 🍝 Armenio's Modern Grandma is a labour of love from Chef Sam Armenio and his son — a family-run Italian restaurant opposite One Bangkok, drawing on 25 years of experience and generations of recipes from southern Italy. The legendary lasagne comes straight from the pot, the truffle pizza has its own fanbase, and the tiramisu has been called the best in Bangkok. Google 4.9, warm service, live music, pet-friendly, and the kind of restaurant that makes you feel like you've been invited to someone's family dinner.
description_zh: 奶奶的義大利秘方，在 One Bangkok 對面悄悄開了一家餐廳 🍝 Armenio's Modern Grandma 由主廚 Sam 與兒子聯手，以義大利南部 Molfetta 家傳食譜為靈感，傳說中的千層麵從鍋裡直接端上桌、松露披薩香氣逼人、提拉米蘇被封為曼谷最好吃，Google 4.9 分、每道菜都是一個家族的故事。
address: 48 Soi Saphan Khu, Khwaeng Thung Maha Mek, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: A five-table gem hiding opposite Wat Pho 🍛 The Sixth 6th is tucked in a charming old shophouse at 6 Maha Rat Road — run by a young couple who cook everything fresh, with a warmth that makes the small space feel like home. Tom yum goong with generous prawns, Panaeng curry that earns repeat orders, and mango sticky rice that wraps the whole meal up perfectly. Cozy, honest, and priced right. The best Thai food stop after a morning at the Grand Palace and Wat Pho — and one of old Bangkok's most beloved hidden gems.
description_zh: 臥佛寺對面巷子裡的家常泰菜小館 🍛 The Sixth 6th 藏在馬哈拉路 6 號的百年老屋裡，只有五張桌子，卻是逛完大皇宮後最讓人感動的一頓飯，冬蔭功酸辣鮮美、Panaeng 咖哩香濃入味、芒果糯米飯甜而不膩，年輕夫妻自己顧店，Google 4.7 分，是老城區最讓人回頭的隱藏美食。
address: 6 Thanon Maha Rat, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Eastern Thailand's freshest seafood, now on the 3rd floor of CentralWorld 🦀 Laem Charoen Seafood has been bringing coastal flavours from Rayong to Bangkok for decades — the deep-fried sea bass with fish sauce is their most celebrated dish, the crab meat rolls are crispy and packed with flavour, and the glass noodles with prawns are a standout worth ordering. Busy, bustling, and genuine — the rare shopping mall seafood restaurant that actually delivers on freshness and taste. Reserve ahead.
description_zh: 羅勇海岸的鮮味，直送 CentralWorld 三樓 🦀 Laem Charoen 來自東部沿海小鎮，以新鮮海鮮和道地泰式料理著稱，炸魚露醬汁海鱸魚外酥鮮甜、螃蟹肉卷酥脆多汁、冬蔭功蝦辣得夠勁，逛街途中最值得坐下來好好吃一頓的海鮮餐廳，記得提前訂位。
address: ชั้นที่ 3, โซน บี 305-306, เซ็นทรัลเวิลด์, 999/9 Thanon Ratchadamri, Khwaeng Pathum Wan, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: Sushi Juban Takumi Thonglor 寿司十番匠トンロー
name_zh: Sushi Juban Takumi Thonglor 寿司十番匠トンロー
description_en: Thonglor's most surprising and personal omakase 🍣 Sushi Juban Takumi is helmed by Japanese Chef Okamura, who crafts 12–14 course seasonal menus with a genuine element of showmanship — guests never quite know what's coming next, and the chef explains every course with warmth and care. Otoro, uni wagyu, and thick-cut sashimi are recurring highlights, all served in an intimate counter setting with a striking wall of wines as backdrop. Lunch omakase from 980 baht, evening courses from 1,800 to 6,500 baht, Google 4.9, and a dining experience that regulars describe as their most fun omakase in Bangkok.
description_zh: 通羅最讓人驚喜連連的 Omakase 🍣 Sushi Juban Takumi 由日本主廚岡村操刀，12 至 14 道季節性套餐每道都藏有驚喜元素，大鮪魚腹、海膽、A5 和牛壽司道道精緻，主廚還會親自提示最佳拍攝時機，整面酒牆氛圍獨特，午間套餐最低 980 銖起，Google 4.9 分，是通羅最值得訂位的日本料理體驗。
address: 36, 1Fl, 1 Soi Phrom Phak, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: TripAdvisor Bangkok top 65, perfect 5.0 rating — the omakase that lives up to every word 🍣 Ryuzu Omakase on the 2nd floor of Marché Thonglor delivers a flawless Edomae-style experience — 16 to 18 seasonal courses with Japanese ingredients flown in weekly, up to five courses of generous uni, melt-in-your-mouth A5 wagyu, and precision sushi-making you watch up close at the counter. Beautiful, calm dining room, perfectly paced service, and chefs who make every guest feel genuinely welcomed. One of Bangkok's finest omakase counters, full stop.
description_zh: TripAdvisor 曼谷第 55 名、評分 5.0 滿分的通羅 Omakase 🍣 Ryuzu Omakase 藏在 Marché Thonglor 二樓，傳統江戶前技法融入創意巧思，18 道套餐海膽多達 5 道、A5 和牛入口即化，食材每週直飛自日本，節奏完美、服務細膩，是曼谷最讓人一吃難忘的壽司體驗之一。
address: ชั้น 2, มาร์เช่, 148 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The 25-layer mille-feuille tonkatsu — Japan's most inventive pork cutlet, now in Thonglor 🥩 Kimukatsu pioneered the technique of stacking 25 ultra-thin pork slices before breading and frying — the result is a cutlet that's crispy outside, impossibly juicy and springy inside, and unlike any tonkatsu you've had before. Choose from classic, black pepper, garlic, cheese, and more. Served with fluffy rice, miso soup, and unlimited cabbage, it's Thailand's first branch and one of Marché Thonglor's most exciting new openings.
description_zh: 法式千層技法遇上日式豬排，泰國首家在通羅 🥩 Kimukatsu 以 25 層薄切豬肉堆疊再油炸的革命性技法聞名全球，外皮酥薄不油膩、每一口都是層層嫩肉的美妙口感，黑椒、大蒜、起司多款口味任你選，搭配白飯、味噌湯、無限高麗菜絲，是 Marché Thonglor 最值得特地去吃一輪的日本豬排。
address: ชั้น2, โครงการ มาร์เก็ต เพลส, Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ekamai's most-loved family-run Isaan kitchen 🌶️ Tamnak Isan is tucked down Sukhumvit 63 — a cozy, no-frills spot run by the ever-smiling owner Phannita, who has built a loyal following of locals and expats for years. The papaya salad with salted egg is a must, the charcoal grilled catfish is a standout, and the crying tiger pork neck is exactly as good as everyone says. Honest prices, big flavours, and the kind of warmth that keeps people coming back every visit to Bangkok.
description_zh: Ekamai 在地人的家常伊善秘食堂 🌶️ Tamnak Isan 藏在素坤逸 63 巷深處，老闆娘 Phannita 每天笑臉迎人，青木瓜沙拉辣勁十足、炭烤鯰魚香氣撲鼻、哭泣老虎烤豬頸肉鮮嫩下飯，價格平實到讓人不敢相信，是曼谷老外和旅人最愛回頭的那種家庭式東北泰菜。
address: 86/1 Sukhumvit Rd, Khwaeng Phra Khanong Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Huai Khwang's best-kept Cantonese dim sum secret 🥟 KungFu Dimsum on New Petchaburi Road punches well above its weight — plump har gow, soup-filled xiao long bao, silky Cantonese congee, and portions double the size of what you'd expect at the price. A genuine find for dim sum lovers willing to venture slightly off the tourist trail.
description_zh: New Petchaburi 路上最值得繞路的廣式飲茶 🥟 KungFu Dimsum 蝦餃晶瑩飽滿、小籠包湯汁四溢、廣式粥滑順如絲，一份份量是普通飲茶店兩倍，價格卻親民驚人，是慧恭一帶飲茶愛好者的口袋名單。
address: 2040 New Petchaburi Rd, Khwaeng Bang Kapi, Khet Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10310, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's new favourite all-day diner 🍞 Butler on the ground floor of Marketplace Thonglor is built around one idea: make serious food fun again. Grilled cheese and tomato soup, pork schnitzel, oxtail cannelloni, a house sourdough bagel programme, and weekend oysters with dry-aged local fish. Relaxed and a little playful — the sort of place you drop into for a quick bite and end up staying for drinks. The most easy, natural addition to Thonglor's dining scene in a while.
description_zh: 「讓認真的食物變得有趣」—— 通羅最新的全天候美式餐館 🍞 Butler 藏在 Marketplace Thonglor 一樓，烤起司三明治配番茄濃湯、豬排佐焦糖洋蔥、手工酸麵包貝果每道都用心製作，乾式熟成肉品週末上場，生蠔也不缺席，隨時可以進來坐一下、吃個飯、不知不覺喝到天黑。
address: 1 FL., Marketplace, ถ. ทองหล่อ แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: Tulum, Mexico — 29 floors above Ekkamai 🌴🔥 Tulum Skybar at Mövenpick Ekkamai is Bangkok's most transportive rooftop — Mayan sculptures, macramé, tropical vines, and a boho-jungle atmosphere that somehow works perfectly above the city skyline. Mezcal and tequila-based cocktails, tacos al pastor, live DJs, and fire performances after dark. Happy hour runs 5–7pm for sunset views, then the energy builds into one of Ekkamai's most vibrant nights out. Dress smart casual and arrive before the crowd.
description_zh: 墨西哥圖盧姆的靈魂降落在 Ekkamai 29 樓 🌴🔥 Tulum Skybar 坐落 Mövenpick Ekkamai 頂樓，馬雅雕塑、編織燈飾、熱帶植物包圍，Aztec Fire 龍舌蘭雞尾酒喝完火焰表演接力，下午五點 Happy Hour 日落入座，DJ 接夜、氛圍越燒越旺，是 Ekkamai 最讓人覺得身在異國的天台夜晚。
address: 559 Soi Sukhumvit 63, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Thonglor's most guilt-free indulgence 🍫 Cacao & Love on Thonglor Soi 13 is the passion project of self-taught baker Anisha Sinchawla — a sunlit pink café where every treat is made without refined sugar, with gluten-free, vegan, and keto-friendly options throughout. Raw peanut butter cacao cheesecake, keto smoked salmon cream cheese bagels, superfood smoothies that taste like strawberry muffins, and a carrot cake yoghurt bowl that converts the sceptics. Beautiful, thoughtful, and proof that healthy food can feel like a treat.
description_zh: 通羅 13 巷最甜蜜的健康革命 🍫 Cacao & Love 由自學烘焙師 Anisha 創立，粉紅牆面配手繪花卉壁畫，每一道甜點都無精製糖、無麩質、無乳製品可選，生花生奶油可可起司蛋糕、Keto 燻鮭魚奶油起司貝果、超級食物冰沙道道驚喜，讓你吃得開心又沒有罪惡感。
address: 267/7 Soi Thong Lo 13, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Chiang Mai's most celebrated roastery, flagship in Thonglor 25 ☕ Pacamara Coffee Roasters set up their Bangkok Specialty Coffee Lab in a charming two-storey standalone house off Thonglor Soi 25 — all beans roasted in-house, rotating with the seasons, and brewed by baristas trained to the highest standard. The snow cold brew with coffee jelly and frozen milk is a signature not found elsewhere, the nitro cold brew is silky smooth, and you can taste before you order. One of Bangkok's most quietly serious coffee destinations.
description_zh: 通羅 25 巷裡的精品烘豆旗艦店 ☕ Pacamara 從清邁起家，在通羅小巷的兩層樓獨棟老屋開設 Specialty Coffee Lab，自家烘焙豆隨季節輪換，Snow Cold Brew 刨冰拿鐵、氮氣冷萃、可樂冷萃都是獨家創作，還可以在點餐前請咖啡師讓你先試喝，是通羅最認真對待咖啡的地方。
address: 66 25 Soi Thong Lo, คลองเตยเหนือ Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Ari's most resort-like all-day brunch spot ☀️ Kaffa: Brunch and Brew sits on the ground floor of Josh Hotel on Phahonyothin Road — uncrowded, unhurried, and with a laid-back pool-adjacent atmosphere that makes Bangkok feel far away. The gnocchi with shrimp in pink vodka sauce is the standout, the Turkish eggs bring a welcome Middle Eastern twist, and the big breakfast platter delivers exactly what you'd hope. House-roasted coffee, open from 8am, and the kind of place that turns a quick brunch into a long, lovely morning.
description_zh: Ari 最像度假村的早午餐咖啡廳 ☀️ Kaffa: Brunch and Brew 藏在 Josh Hotel 一樓，戶外有泳池景、空間寬敞不擁擠，蝦仁粉紅伏特加醬義大利麵疙瘩、土耳其蛋、豐盛早午餐拼盤道道用心，自家烘焙咖啡師親手沖製，隨時可以進來，悠悠閒閒吃到下午。
address: 19, 2 Phahon Yothin Road, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Ari's best specialty coffee — hidden inside a parking garage ☕ Aribica has been quietly championing Thai-grown coffee beans since 2018, tucked in the Sahakorn building off Ari Soi 1. Walk past the barrier and you'll find a tiny, warm counter where baristas hand-grind every order. The Cookies and Cream house blend long black has earned its own fanbase, the Dirty Coffee is layered and perfectly balanced, and all beans come from Thai farmers. Worth the small adventure of finding it.
description_zh: 停車場裡藏著 Ari 最好喝的精品咖啡 ☕ Aribica 自 2018 年起在 Ari 1 巷默默深耕，專注推廣泰國本土咖啡農，Cookies and Cream 特調豆被評為曼谷最驚喜的 Long Black，Dirty Coffee 層次豐富、苦甜平衡，吧台師一顆顆手磨現沖，找到入口的那一刻就覺得一切值得。
address: 4, 1 Soi Ari 1, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: The most eye-catching café at the Talat Noi roundabout ☕ Sunset Coffee Roaster made its name on Pattaya Beach before bringing its roastery culture to this beautifully renovated old building on Charoen Krung Road. Red-trimmed floor-to-ceiling windows, 1980s vintage wood-and-blue interiors, and a DJ spinning vinyl set it apart from every other café on the street. The yuzu americano with rosemary is a refreshing must-try, the matcha selection is serious (Fukuoka 1st grade!), and the retail beans make a great takeaway. Open until late and just a 5-minute walk from MRT Hua Lamphong.
description_zh: 老曼谷圓環路口最搶眼的復古烘豆咖啡廳 ☕ Sunset Coffee Roaster 從芭提雅海灘出發，落腳 Talat Noi 一棟改建老街屋，紅框落地窗、復古 80 年代木質藍調空間，DJ 播著黑膠音樂，柚子美式配迷迭香清爽提神、Cloudy Latte 入門必試，自家烘焙豆可以外帶回家，是逛完 Talat Noi 最值得在路口坐下來休息的一間。
address: 741 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Talat Noi, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

name_en: Midsummer Cafe & Roastery SONGWAT | Thai Coffee
name_zh: Midsummer Cafe & Roastery SONGWAT | Thai Coffee
description_en: Songwat's most characterful Thai coffee roastery ☕ Midsummer Cafe & Roastery on Yaowapanich Road is a COE Thailand National Jury brand (2023 & 2025), housed in a beautifully restored heritage shophouse with a golden logo that catches your eye before you even notice the coffee. The signature Klin Song Wat espresso is named after the neighbourhood, the Siamese Smile Thai milk tea is a playful local interpretation, and the rotating single-origin Thai beans are sourced with genuine care. Two floors of vintage architecture plus an upstairs balcony — one of the best stops on any Songwat coffee walk.
description_zh: 宋瓦路最有溫度的泰國精品烘豆咖啡廳 ☕ Midsummer 是 2025 年 COE 泰國國家評審品牌，宋瓦百年老街屋改建空間、金色招牌外觀鮮明，招牌 Klin Song Wat 濃縮以宋瓦地區風土命名、暹邏微笑泰式奶茶是在地詮釋，單品手沖嚴選泰北豆、也可帶走自家烘豆，是探索唐人街新生咖啡文化的最佳起點。
address: 152, 1 Yaowapanich Road, Khwaeng Chakkrawat, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: The most unhurried brunch spot in the Pridi 26 neighbourhood 🥑 Prove is tucked down a quiet soi off Sukhumvit 71 — a small, warm café that feels genuinely like home. The all-day menu covers healthy bowls, brunch classics, and nourishing plates like the Mexican bowl and wellness bowl, all made with care and simplicity. Pet-friendly, kid-friendly, and exactly the kind of place you come for coffee and stay through lunch. Open Tuesday to Sunday from 8am, closed Mondays.
description_zh: Pridi 26 巷裡最讓人想慢下來的早午餐小館 🥑 prove 藏在素坤逸 71 巷的安靜角落，空間小巧溫暖如家，全天早午餐、健康輕食、酪梨碗、墨西哥碗道道用心，Mexican Bowl 和 Wellness Bowl 是常客必點，寵物友善、氣氛慵懶舒適，週二至週日早八開門，是 Ekkamai 一帶最讓人自願待到下午的那種地方。
address: 2 Sukhumvit 71 Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A little slice of Paris tucked off Witthayu Road 🥐 Café Tartine has been serving fresh croissants and honest French café fare since 2009 — the signature Eggs Dolphin Bay Benedict is the dish to order, the build-your-own baguette lets you customize a hearty lunch, and the lemon meringue pie pairs beautifully with jasmine tea. Generous portions, warm and attentive service, and a quiet, cozy atmosphere just steps from BTS Ploenchit. The kind of café that turns a quick coffee stop into a long, relaxed morning.
description_zh: Ruamrudee 巷弄裡的巴黎早餐時光 🥐 Café Tartine 自 2009 年起在這裡飄香，新鮮現烤可頌、招牌 Dolphin Bay 班尼迪克蛋是必點，自由組合的法式長棍三明治、檸檬蛋白霜派配茉莉花茶完美收尾，份量大方、價格親民，是逛 Ploenchit 一帶最值得放慢腳步的法式咖啡廳。
address: 65 2 Thanon Witthayu, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: A quietly excellent rooftop tucked in Charoen Krung 50 🌆 On Top Rooftop Bar sits on the 5th floor of a building down this charming alley in Bang Rak — rated 4.8 by guests, and far less crowded than the big-name rooftops nearby. A solid choice for travelers who want skyline views and good cocktails without the tourist scrum.
description_zh: 曼隆 50 巷裡的低調精緻天台 🌆 On Top Rooftop Bar 藏在 Charoen Krung 50 巷的五樓，Google 評分高達 4.8，不像鄰近大牌天台般擁擠喧鬧，是這一帶在地人才知道的安靜選擇，適合想避開觀光人潮、好好享受曼谷夜景的那種夜晚。
address: 5th floor, 53 Charoen Krung 50 Alley, Bangrak, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A hidden 1920s European speakeasy, 24 floors above Langsuan 🥃 The Speakeasy at Hotel Muse spans two floors of golden Art Deco glamour — a glowing dome bar downstairs, and a secret staircase behind a painting leading to a quieter rooftop terrace above. Over 50 premium gins, cocktails inspired by King Rama V's royal travels, and the Blind Pig Cigar Lounge for an extra layer of old-world indulgence. Live jazz, weekend DJ sets, and a five-minute walk from BTS Chit Lom. Smart casual, and best enjoyed slowly with a martini in hand.
description_zh: 1920 年代歐洲的秘密酒吧，藏在 Langsuan 上空 🥃 The Speakeasy 坐落 Hotel Muse 24-25 樓，金色圓頂與隱藏樓梯後是另一個世界，超過 50 款琴酒、招牌調酒以拉瑪五世國王的旅行故事為靈感，畫作後方的密道通往樓上更隱密的天台，Blind Pig 雪茄室適合愛好者，週末現場 DJ 接力，是 Chidlom 一帶最有戲劇感的調酒夜晚。
address: 55, 555 Lang Suan Rd, Khwaeng Lumphini, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Front-row seats to Wat Arun, no crowds required 🌅 TYME Rooftop sits on the 5th floor of INN A DAY, a boutique hotel near Wat Pho — and it's quietly become one of the area's best-kept secrets. Golden hour lights up the temple spires across the river; after dark, Wat Arun glows and reflects on the water below. Low-key but never dull, with attentive service, decent cocktails, and crispy beef nachos that regulars order every visit. Reservations recommended for window seats — the view alone is worth the trip.
description_zh: 鄭王廟正對面，曼谷最值得安靜坐下來的天台 🌅 TYME Rooftop 藏在 INN A DAY 飯店五樓，是 Wat Pho 一帶最讓人意外的隱藏景點，夕陽把鄭王廟染成金色、入夜後廟身燈光倒映河面，氛圍低調卻迷人、調酒師認真調製手中那一杯，牛肉莎莎脆餅是常客必點，是觀光人潮裡最值得提前訂位的那個安靜角落。
address: 5th Floor, INN A DAY, Maharaj - Tha Tien, Khwaeng Phra Borom Maha Ratchawang, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Find the wooden door, find Bangkok's best cocktails 🐇 Rabbit Hole on Thonglor Road has no sign — just an unmarked wooden door between Soi 5 and 7. Step inside and discover a three-storey converted shophouse with a marble bar, floor-to-ceiling copper spirit rack, and two Diageo World Class champion bartenders behind the counter. The Cosa Nostra — cherry-infused cognac in a cigar-smoked glass — is the signature. Consistently ranked among Asia's 50 Best Bars, and still feels like a secret worth keeping.
description_zh: 找到那扇木門，就找到了曼谷最好的調酒 🐇 Rabbit Hole 藏在通羅路 5-7 巷之間，沒有招牌只有一扇木門，走進三層樓老街屋、大理石吧台、玫瑰金酒架映入眼簾，由 Diageo World Class 冠軍調酒師掌杯，Cosa Nostra 煙燻威士忌是必點，連亞洲 50 最佳酒吧也認證，是通羅夜晚最值得尋找的地方。
address: 125 Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Asia's 50 Best Bars No. 5, where two classics become one glass 🌊 Dry Wave Cocktail Studio sits on the 2nd floor of SODALITY in Thonglor Soi 13 — wave-patterned sandstone walls, terracotta marble bar, and a treehouse feel with a mature tree growing right through the outdoor terrace. Bartender Palm Muttarattana's "Super Classic" menu splices two eras of cocktails into one: a Negroni-Espresso Martini hybrid, and the must-try Morning Tijuana, blending a mezcal margarita with a breakfast martini for a bold strawberry-paprika finish. Intimate, artistic, and one of Bangkok's most inventive bars right now.
description_zh: 亞洲 50 最佳酒吧第 5 名，把兩杯經典調成一杯 🌊 Dry Wave Cocktail Studio 藏在通羅 13 巷 SODALITY 二樓，沙浪紋牆面與陶土色大理石吧台打造祕境氛圍，調酒師 Palm 把 Negroni 與 Espresso Martini 融合成一杯、招牌 Morning Tijuana 結合梅斯卡爾瑪格麗特與早餐馬丁尼，戶外露台環繞一棵老樹，是曼谷最值得慢慢品的調酒實驗室。
address: SODALITY 2nd Floor, 263 Soi Thong Lo 13, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A rooftop hiding behind a parking garage elevator 🥃 Another Round sits on Thonglor Soi 13 — take the lift up from what looks like a parking entrance, and you land somewhere unexpectedly polished: warm brown tones, mirrored surfaces catching the skyline, and a live singer most nights from around 8pm. It feels more like a regulars' spot than a headline venue, the kind of place that fills through word of mouth. The dry-aged beef and pad krapao both hold their own. Tables with a view go fast before 9pm — time your arrival, then let the night slow down from there.
description_zh: 停車場電梯直達的通羅天台秘境 🥃 Another Round 藏在通羅 13 巷某棟大樓的停車場入口，搭電梯上樓後別有洞天，暖棕色調與鏡面映著城市天際線，每晚約八點有現場歌手駐唱，氛圍更像熟客的私房聚點而非熱門打卡點，乾式熟成牛排、打拋豬都夠水準，傍晚九點前先搶到看景座位，夜晚就慢慢沉浸其中。
address: Soi Thong Lo, Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The unmarked wooden door hiding inside a hotel 🚪 Thaipioka is tucked inside Salil Hotel on Thonglor Soi 1 — step through the door and you're into a warm, teak-heavy room with soft orange lighting and just enough greenery to soften the edges. Easy to reach from BTS Thonglor in under 10 minutes, it sets the tone early for a night out in the neighbourhood: understated, polished, and quietly confident from the very first sip.
description_zh: Salil 飯店裡的無名木門酒吧 🚪 Thaipioka 藏在通羅 1 巷的 Salil Hotel 內，推開那扇沒有招牌的木門，迎面是暖橘燈光與滿室柚木的溫潤空間、綠植點綴其中，是通羅酒吧路線的最佳起點，氛圍低調卻有質感，從 BTS 通羅站走進來不到十分鐘，是夜晚慢慢開始的最佳第一站。
address: 44/7, Thonglor Soi 1, Salil Hotel, 55 ถ. สุขุมวิท แขวงคลองตันเหนือ เขตวัฒนา กรุงเทพมหานคร 10110, Thailand

description_en: A speakeasy hiding behind a photo booth 🌊 BECKA BAR sits on the 9th floor of The Residence on Thonglor — soaring ceilings, a glass wall opening onto the skyline, and ten signature cocktails each inspired by a body of water from six different regions. The Salty Dog is the crowd favourite, live music plays nightly, and the chic, elegant interior makes it equally suited to a date night or a night out with friends. Open daily from 5pm, sunset views start around 5:30.
description_zh: 照片牆後藏著一間秘密酒吧 🌊 BECKA BAR 坐落 The Residence on Thonglor 九樓，玻璃高牆引進城市天際線，靈感取自全球六大洲的水域、十款招牌調酒各有故事，招牌 Salty Dog 是常客必點，每晚現場音樂、氛圍親密低調，是通羅夜晚約會或聚會最值得收進口袋的隱藏酒吧。
address: The Resident on Thong Lo 9 Floor, 73 Sukhumvit 55 (Thonglor Khwaeng Khlong Tan Nuea, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's only gangster-themed speakeasy 🕰️ Abandoned Mansion is hidden in the basement of a hotel on Sukhumvit 14, near Asoke BTS — Prohibition Era vibes, gold-copper-blue vintage interiors, and cocktails named after notorious 1920s outlaws like Al Capone and Bonnie and Clyde. Live jazz every single night, a dedicated cigar room, and a 4.9 rating ranking it #21 of nearly 9,000 Bangkok restaurants on Tripadvisor. The kind of place that makes you forget what decade you're in.
description_zh: 曼谷唯一的黑幫主題地下酒吧 🕰️ Abandoned Mansion 藏在 Asoke BTS 旁飯店的地下室，禁酒令時代風情、金銅藍色調裝潢，調酒以歷史黑幫人物命名、Bonnie and Clyde 是常客最愛，每晚現場爵士樂演出，雪茄室與酒窖一應俱全，Tripadvisor 曼谷餐廳第 21 名、4.9 高分，是一秒穿越 1920 年代的曼谷夜晚。
address: 41 Soi Sukhumvit 14, Klongtoey, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A jazz café-bar dressed as a fairytale castle 🏰 Thee & Thou sits on Ratchawithi Road, with every corner filled with intricate details that feel straight out of a Disney animation. The live jazz reinterprets familiar movie soundtracks in swing or bossa nova arrangements — relaxing, genuinely joyful, and proof that jazz doesn't have to be moody to work. The cocktails match the theme: visually enchanting, well-balanced, never style over substance. Open daily 7:30am to midnight — equal parts romantic and nostalgic.
description_zh: 童話城堡裡的爵士咖啡酒吧 🏰 Thee & Thou 藏在拉差威提路上，每個角落都精緻得像迪士尼動畫場景，現場爵士樂以搖擺或波薩諾瓦改編你熟悉的電影配樂，調酒也呼應童話主題、視覺夢幻卻不失層次，從早上 7:30 到午夜，是曼谷少見既浪漫又帶點童心的爵士酒吧咖啡廳。
address: 459/3-4 Thanon Ratchawithi, Khwaeng Thanon Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's jazz institution since 1985 🎷 Brown Sugar has moved a few times — from Sarasin Langsuan to its current home on Soi Nana, Chinatown — but the old-school charm has never changed. Acoustic sets kick off at 8pm, full bands take over by 10pm, spanning jazz, blues, soul, and funk, with Saturday night's "Motherfunky" set drawing regulars from across the city. Crisp nachos, solid Thai basil chicken, and over four decades of live music credibility. No cover charge, just walk in and find a seat.
description_zh: 1985 年至今，曼谷爵士樂的活招牌 🎷 Brown Sugar 從沙拉信路一路搬到中國城那那巷，骨子裡的老派魅力始終未變，每晚現場演出從八點木吉他組開始、十點搖身一變樂團大秀，爵士、藍調、靈魂樂輪番上陣，週六深夜「Motherfunky」場更是常客必追的夜晚，配上招牌玉米片與泰式打拋雞，40 年功力一聽便知。
address: 18 ซ. นานา Khwaeng Pom Prap, Khet Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: The blues bar regulars call the best in Asia 🎸 Adhere The 13th is run by a couple whose love for blues and reggae built this tiny gem just off Khao San Road — small enough that the band plays a few feet from your table. Acoustic sets start around 8:30pm, full bands take over by 10pm, and the crowd is a genuine mix of locals and travelers who keep coming back night after night. Cash only, no frills, just real music and real atmosphere. More house party than bar — and unforgettable because of it.
description_zh: 亞洲最好的藍調酒吧，就藏在考山路旁的小巷 🎸 Adhere The 13th 由一對熱愛藍調與雷鬼的夫妻創立，空間迷你卻塞滿靈魂，樂手就坐在離你幾步遠的地方演奏，每晚酒吧駐唱從 8 點木吉他組開始，10 點全團上陣，常客連續三晚都捨不得離開，比起酒吧，更像一場放鬆的家庭派對。
address: 13 Thanon Samsen, Khwaeng Wat Sam Phraya, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A 46th-floor glass floor, surprisingly affordable for the view 🌆 Cielo Sky Bar sits atop Skywalk Condominium in the W District, just steps from BTS Phra Khanong — far from the tourist circuit but with a genuinely impressive 360-degree panorama. Art Deco design meets 1960s elegance, the Thai Mojito is a local favourite, and the glass-floor skywalk adds a thrilling extra (not for the faint-hearted). Quieter, friendlier, and easier on the wallet than Bangkok's more famous rooftops — and the sunset here is just as stunning.
description_zh: 46 樓玻璃地板，比想像中更實惠的天際線 🌆 Cielo Sky Bar 藏在 Phra Khanong 的 Skywalk 公寓頂樓，遠離觀光人潮卻擁有 360 度全景視野，Art Deco 裝潢混搭 1960 年代優雅，泰式莫吉托、玻璃步道刺激好玩，距離 BTS Phra Khanong 站只要 5 分鐘，是曼谷天台酒吧中少數價格親民又不擁擠的隱藏選擇。
address: 1595/ 500 Sukhumvit Rd, พระโขนงเหนือ Watthana, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: A spy-themed hideout on the 6th floor of Passa Hotel 🕵️ ROGUE AFFAIR gives nothing away from street level — take the lift up and discover a constantly rotating concept, from a James Bond casino theme to a John Wick-inspired "Continental" night, complete with matching cocktails and décor. Signature drinks like The Janitor and Casablanca are crafted by competition-trained bartenders, with DJs spinning Friday and Saturday nights. A short walk from Patpong and Lumphini Park — and one of Silom's best-kept cocktail secrets.
description_zh: 特務主題酒吧藏在 Passa Hotel 六樓 🕵️ ROGUE AFFAIR 從外觀完全看不出端倪，搭電梯上樓才發現別有洞天，主題每季更換、曾以「John Wick: The Continental」為靈感打造整套調酒與裝潢，招牌 The Janitor、Casablanca 各有風格，週五六現場 DJ 接力，是矽隆巷弄裡最讓人意外驚喜的隱藏酒吧。
address: 63 Soi Convent 2, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

name_en: Wine Climats ไวน์ คลีม่า
name_zh: Wine Climats ไวน์ คลีม่า
description_en: Thailand's first dedicated Burgundy wine bar, tucked off busy Silom Road 🍷 Wine Climats is the brainchild of Khun A, one of Thailand's most prolific Burgundy importers, with a list built around the owner's own imports — names like Lafarge, Arnoux-Lachaux, and Domaine des Comtes Lafon, all at fair mark-ups. Around 20 seats only, so call ahead. A Le Cordon Bleu-trained chef crafts the French menu to match, with soft live music every Friday night. Intimate, knowledgeable, and exactly the kind of hidden gem wine lovers hope to stumble upon in Bangkok.
description_zh: 泰國第一家勃根地葡萄酒專門酒吧，藏在矽隆巷弄裡 🍷 Wine Climats 由深耕勃根地酒業十二年的老闆 Khun A 創立，僅 20 個座位卻收藏 Lafarge、Domaine des Comtes Lafon 等名莊珍釀，Le Cordon Bleu 主廚掌廚的法式料理完美襯托每一杯，每週五夜晚有現場音樂輕輕流瀉，氛圍親密卻不拘謹，是矽隆最值得提前訂位的那杯紅酒。
address: 2nd Floor, 281/16 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: The Wine Merchant's most ambitious venue yet, inside Park Silom 🍷 This newest addition to The Wine Merchant's growing portfolio pairs the brand's signature well-curated, well-priced selection with a serious kitchen — premium cold cuts, artisanal cheeses, and a handful of pasta mains and other dishes. The focus leans classic Europe, with an especially deep showing from Bordeaux, Champagne, and Austria across a wide range of price points and vintages. A polished, reliable choice for business drinks or a proper wine date in the heart of Silom.
description_zh: Park Silom 裡最高端的葡萄酒之選 🍷 The Wine Merchant 在矽隆全新落成的 Park Silom 商場開設旗艦店，是品牌目前最具規模的酒吧，精選歐洲經典產區為主、波爾多與香檳選擇尤其豐富，搭配頂級冷盤起司與義大利麵主菜，價格範圍橫跨各年份各檔次，是矽隆商務聚會或品酒約會的理想之選。
address: G-FLOOR, PARK SILOM BUILDING, 1 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A New York subway tunnel, tucked into Silom 🚇 Pili Pala Drunken Room channels American subway design into a narrow space with curved ceilings and stylized walls — just 30 seats, shoulder-to-shoulder, like chatting with strangers on the train ride home. The Cacao Old Fashioned blends coffee beans and cacao for a fragrant caffeinated twist, and the Grape Manhattan comes finished with a frozen grape. Natural wines, craft beers, and live DJs Thursday through Saturday spinning disco, house, and hip-hop. Unpretentious and easy to love.
description_zh: 紐約地鐵搬進矽隆巷弄裡 🚇 Pili Pala Drunken Room 以美式地鐵為靈感打造彎曲天花板與隧道造型內裝，僅 30 個座位卻擠出親密氛圍，像跟陌生人肩並肩搭車回家一樣自在，招牌可可古典雞尾酒咖啡香氣十足、葡萄曼哈頓加了一顆冰凍葡萄，週四至週六現場 DJ 接力，是矽隆最不拘謹的小酒館。
address: Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: BK Magazine's Best Wine Bar three years running — and Star Wine List certified 2025 & 2026 🍷 Mod Kaew moved from its original Phloen Chit home to a bigger, more polished space in Sathorn Soi 12, but kept everything that made it great: walls lined with bottles, low-intervention Spanish and French wines at refreshingly fair markups, and staff who talk about wine like they love it rather than sell it. Ask to see the upstairs cellar — it's a treasure trove. Outdoor terrace, parking available, open Tuesday to Sunday until 1am. The wine bar that quietly started Bangkok's natural wine revolution.
description_zh: BK Magazine 三連霸最佳葡萄酒吧、Star Wine List 2025 & 2026 雙年認證 🍷 Mod Kaew 從 Ploenchit 搬到 Sathorn 12 巷後更大更有底氣，瓶牆滿目、天然低干預西班牙與法國精選葡萄酒定價公道，地下酒窖隨時歡迎探索，露台開到凌晨一點，是曼谷最不裝模作樣、最讓人一喝就愛上的自然葡萄酒吧。
