address: 142 Soi Sueksa Wittaya, ซ. สาทร 12 แขวงสีลม เขตบางรัก กรุงเทพมหานคร 10500, Thailand

description_en: You have to find the door first 🚪 YOU KNOW WHERE on Silom Road 185 takes its cue from Harry Potter's Platform 9¾ — three doors, one real entrance, and the adventure starts before the first sip. Inside: inventive signature cocktails like a Tiramisu Cocktail and a layered Old Fashioned, or roll the dice and let the bartender decide your fate. Small, cozy, conversation-friendly, and 5.0 on Tripadvisor. Open daily from 6pm, until 1:30am on weekends. The most fun puzzle bar in Silom — if you can find the way in.
description_zh: 進得去才算找到這間酒吧 🚪 YOU KNOW WHERE 藏在矽隆路 185 號，三扇門只有一扇是真的入口，靈感取自哈利波特九又四分之三月台，招牌提拉米蘇調酒、老式威士忌各有風格，不知道喝什麼可以擲骰子讓調酒師決定，Tripadvisor 5.0 滿分，是矽隆最有趣的一個調酒夜晚。
address: 185 Si Lom Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A peaceful boutique hideaway tucked just off busy Silom Road 🏡 Amber Boutique Silom offers 19 stylish themed rooms — Moroccan, Sino-Portuguese, and modern contemporary — all on a quiet alley just five minutes walk from BTS Chong Nonsi. The open-air tropical atrium breakfast area sets a relaxed tone, rooms are consistently praised for cleanliness and comfort, and the price-to-location ratio is genuinely hard to beat in central Bangkok. A calm, characterful base for exploring the city.
description_zh: 矽隆最靜謐的精品飯店，就藏在繁忙主街後的小巷 🏡 Amber Boutique Silom 提供摩洛哥、葡式南洋、現代簡約三種主題客房，步行五分鐘到 BTS Chong Nonsi 站，熱帶中庭早餐區讓你一早就切換度假模式。
address: 200 Soi Silom 14, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A tropical garden hideaway in the heart of Bangkok's business district 🌿 Silom Serene is tucked down Soi Pipat — just five minutes walk from both BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Silom, yet wrapped in lush greenery, a pool, Jacuzzi, and a sundeck that make the city feel very far away. Spacious rooms, staff who greet returning guests by name, a solid buffet breakfast with made-to-order eggs, and an in-house Thai restaurant for late nights. Excellent value for the location, and consistently one of Silom's most recommended boutique stays for travellers who want comfort without the noise.
description_zh: 矽隆商業核心裡最意外的熱帶綠洲 🌿 Silom Serene 藏在 Soi Pipat 小巷，泳池、按摩浴缸、熱帶花園讓你忘記身在商圈，客房寬敞舒適、工作人員以賓客姓氏親切招呼，步行五分鐘到 BTS Sala Daeng 與 MRT Silom，Ormthong 餐廳的泰式料理與現做蛋捲早餐同樣讓人期待，是矽隆最值得安靜住下來的精品飯店。
address: 7 สาทร ซอย 3 Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A boutique gem steps from Patpong, with a rooftop bar to match 🍸 Heaven Boutique Hotel tucks 20 clean, well-appointed rooms into Silom Plaza on Silom Road — spotless showers, Smart TVs, and a complimentary welcome drink waiting at the rooftop bar on arrival. The rooftop serves cocktails and international food with city views and live music, breakfast is a hearty American spread, and BTS Sala Daeng is a five-minute walk. Great value for the location, and a friendly team that genuinely tries to make every stay feel special.
description_zh: Patpong 旁最實惠的精品飯店，頂樓還有調酒吧 🍸 Heaven Boutique Hotel 藏在矽隆路 Silom Plaza 裡，僅 20 間客房、設計精緻，免費歡迎調酒等你入住，頂樓吧台有城市視野與現場音樂，步行五分鐘到 BTS Sala Daeng，豐盛美式早餐包含，是曼谷矽隆最超值的精品住宿之一。
address: 491, 44, สีลมพลาซ่า 43 Silom Road, แขวงสีลม เขตบางรัก กรุงเทพมหานคร 10500, Thailand

description_en: Elegant boutique hotel offering chic accommodations with Japanese wood tubs, plus a library/lounge.
description_zh: 曼谷熱門飯店。
address: 6, 11 Decho Rd, Khwaeng Suriya Wong, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A quiet zen retreat tucked into the heart of Silom 🌿 SO Zen Hotel on Soi Pramote off Surawong Road is the kind of find that makes Bangkok feel manageable — newly renovated, clean, and genuinely peaceful despite its central location. The Sook Kati Bistro serves a solid Thai and Asian breakfast, the garden terrace is a welcome escape from the street, and BTS Surasak is just a seven-minute walk. Great value for the Silom area, with friendly staff and a private entrance that adds a nice sense of arrival.
description_zh: 矽隆鬧區裡最平靜的禪意小旅館 🌿 SO Zen Hotel 藏在素拉旺路 Pramote 巷弄深處，新裝潢乾淨清爽、花園露台讓人意外安靜，一樓 Sook Kati 餐廳早餐用心豐盛，步行七分鐘到 BTS Surasak，價格親民到讓人驚喜，是矽隆出差或旅遊最值得選的清爽小住所。
address: 64 Soi, ซอย ปราโมทย์ Suriyawong, เขตบางรัก กรุงเทพมหานคร 10500, Thailand

description_en: Silom's warmest hostel, with a MahaNakhon view to wake up to 🏙️ Warm Window Silom is tucked on peaceful Pan Road — a spotlessly clean hostel with private rooms on the upper floors offering direct views of the MahaNakhon tower, and dorm pods with individual curtains, lights, and lockers. The ground-floor café serves solid Thai food that regulars visit even without staying. Seven minutes walk to BTS Surasak, 10 to the river pier. Friendly staff, included breakfast, and the kind of welcoming atmosphere that makes you book one more night.
description_zh: 矽隆最溫暖的背包旅館，窗外就是 MahaNakhon 🏙️ Warm Window Silom 藏在 Pan Road 安靜巷弄，私人客房直視 MahaNakhon 塔、宿舍床位整潔有隱私簾，一樓咖啡廳泰式料理大受好評，步行七分鐘到 BTS Surasak，是矽隆最適合獨旅或小資旅行者的溫馨落腳點。
address: 50, 18-19 Thanon Pan, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: A Bangkok institution since 1977 — crab omelette for 59 baht 🦀 Absorn Thai Bistro has been serving honest Thai home cooking on Maha Chai Road for nearly 50 years, with over 20 branches across Bangkok. The crab omelette is fluffy and packed with crab meat, the pad krapow delivers serious wok heat, and service comes with complimentary snacks and house-made coconut ice cream. Google 4.5 from thousands of reviews, and the best value meal you'll find near the Grand Palace.
description_zh: 1977 年老字號泰菜、螃蟹炒蛋才 59 銖 🦀 Absorn Thai Bistro 在馬哈猜路傳承近 50 年、連開 20 家分店，螃蟹炒蛋蓬鬆鮮美、打拋豬鑊氣十足、螃蟹炒飯份量大方，服務像家人一樣招待，還附贈小點心與椰子冰淇淋，是大皇宮附近最讓人驚喜的道地家常泰菜。
address: 232 - 240 Mahachai Road Sumranrath 232 Maha Chai Rd, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A southern Thai family kitchen, tucked into a Phaya Thai soi 🌶️ Baan Sapaitai carries the recipes of a beloved mother-in-law from Surat Thani — stir-fried stink beans, coconut curries, curry puffs, and bold southern spice pastes made the traditional way. Open daily from 8am for everything from breakfast rice porridge to a proper evening meal. Warm, homestyle, and the kind of restaurant that makes you feel like you've been invited into someone's family kitchen.
description_zh: Phaya Thai 巷弄裡最誠實的南部泰菜 🌶️ Baan Sapaitai 由一位嫁入南部家族的媳婦傳承婆婆食譜，炒臭豆、南部咖哩泡芙、椰奶咖哩道道保留蘇叻他尼的傳統風味，早上八點就開門、每天日開到晚，是 Ari 一帶吃道地南部家常菜最溫暖的選擇。
address: 89 Soi Phahonyothin 3, Phaya Thai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Shoes off, river on — dining at grandma's, right on the Chao Phraya 🌅 Steve Cafe & Cuisine is tucked inside a 60-year-old traditional Thai house in the grounds of a 300-year-old temple near Thewet pier. The riverside deck makes it one of Bangkok's most beautiful dining settings, the grilled pork with lemongrass and chili has its own fanbase, and Steve's home-cooked philosophy means every dish is made fresh and with care. Tripadvisor Top 342 in Bangkok. It takes a bit of finding — worth every wrong turn.
description_zh: 脫鞋入內、像在奶奶家吃飯的昭披耶河畔泰菜 🌅 Steve Cafe & Cuisine 藏在 60 年老泰式木屋裡、緊靠著 300 年古廟 Wat Thewarat，昭披耶河就在腳下流過，香茅烤豬、炸鱸魚、辣蝦炒臭豆道道道地，夕陽染紅河面是最佳入座時刻，Tripadvisor 曼谷前 350 名，找到路就值了。
address: 68, ซอยศรีอยุธยา 21 Si Ayutthaya Rd, Khwaeng Wachira Phayaban, Khet Dusit, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10300, Thailand

description_en: An 80-year-old Thai-Chinese kitchen, right off Democracy Monument 🍜 Mit Ko Yuan on Dinso Road has been serving old-school central Thai and Western Thai recipes since the 1960s — the tom yum goong with massive freshwater prawns is consistently called one of Bangkok's best, the crispy rice noodles (mee krob) follow a 100-year-old recipe, and the braised beef tongue is the kind of dish you don't find elsewhere. Under 250 baht per person, packed with locals, and the resident cat will probably greet you at the door.
description_zh: 80 年老字號、民主紀念碑旁的泰中家常食堂 🍜 Mit Ko Yuan 的脆炸米粉食譜傳承超過百年，冬蔭功鮮蝦湯酸辣鮮美是曼谷最佳之一，炒空心菜炸得鬆酥、燉牛舌細膩入味，一人只要 150-250 銖，店貓、木椅、綠色桌面，吃一口像回到 1960 年代的老曼谷。
address: 186 Dinso Rd, Khwaeng Sao Chingcha, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: The best meal next to Don Mueang Airport 🌶️ SPICE Thai Cuisine and Bar sits right beside DMK Airport, serving authentic Thai dishes from across all regions alongside local craft beers, wine, and live music. Open daily until 2am — whether you're fuelling up before a flight or extending the night, this is the most convenient spot near Don Mueang that doesn't feel like an airport restaurant.
description_zh: 廊曼機場旁的深夜泰菜好去處 🌶️ SPICE Thai Cuisine and Bar 就在廊曼機場隔壁，匯集泰國各地風味料理、本地精釀啤酒與現場音樂，每天從早上十一點開到凌晨兩點，無論是候機前想吃頓好的，還是深夜不想結束夜晚，這裡都是最好的答案。
address: 187 10 Thep Rak Rd, Khwaeng Khlong Thanon, Khet Sai Mai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10220, Thailand

description_en: Fifty years of the best two-colour Hainanese chicken rice in Bangkok 🍚 Jek Meng on Banthat Thong Road has been drawing loyal crowds since the days it was a humble street cart. The signature "two-colour" plate puts silky poached white chicken alongside crispy fried chicken on the same dish — tender and crunchy in every bite, paired with fragrant chicken-fat rice and a comforting bitter gourd soup. Opens at 1:45pm, Monday to Saturday. Get there early or get in line.
description_zh: 半世紀老店的雙色海南雞飯，不用出國就能吃到 🍚 Jek Meng 在班塔通路默默傳承超過 50 年，招牌「雙色雞飯」同盤端上水嫩白斬雞與酥脆炸雞，搭配香濃雞油飯與苦瓜湯，薑蒜辣醬自己調整辣度，下午一點半才開門，記得趁早報到。
address: 112/1-3 Charat Mueang Alley, Khwaeng Rong Muang, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: The chicken rice worth detour-ing to near Chatuchak 🍚 Je Aoun at Bang Khen Market on Phahon Yothin 32/1 is one of Bangkok's most-loved khao mun gai spots — silky poached chicken, fragrant chicken-fat rice, and what many regulars call the most aromatic ginger-chili sauce in the city. The fried chicken option is equally excellent. Open almost all day, cash only, and the kind of no-frills stand where the food does all the talking.
description_zh: 恰圖恰市場旁 Foursquare 評分 8.3 的海南雞飯傳奇 🍚 Je Aoun 就在 Bang Khen 市場裡，水嫩白斬雞肉嫩骨香、炸雞酥脆不油膩、薑蒜辣醬是曼谷最芬芳的一款，雞油飯粒粒飽滿，一碗熱雞湯收尾，是來逛 Chatuchak 前必繞道的那一碗，幾乎全天候開放。
address: Soi Phahon Yothin 32/1, Khwaeng Lat Yao, Khet Chatuchak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10900, Thailand

description_en: Chinatown's most understated chicken rice gem 🍚 Tucked next to the famous Hua Seng Hong on Yaowarat Road, Tanbo Chicken Rice serves Singapore-style khao mun gai that quietly earned a Top 10 Bangkok Chicken Rice award. The yellow-tinted rice cooked in chicken broth and fat is the standout — more aromatic and satisfying than most. Silky poached chicken, Thai-style chili-ginger sauce, complimentary soup, all from 60 baht. Easy to walk past, impossible to regret stopping.
description_zh: 耀華力主街上最低調的雞飯傳奇 🍚 Tanbo Chicken Rice 就在華聖洪隔壁，60 銖一盤、新加坡風格海南雞飯，雞油飯泛著淡黃光澤、香氣比一般店更濃郁，嫩滑白斬雞配泰式薑蒜辣醬，隨附清甜雞湯，榮獲曼谷十大雞飯獎項，逛完中國城必繞進來的一盤。
address: 301 Yaowarat Rd, Khwaeng Samphanthawong, Khet Samphanthawong, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: Banthat Thong Road's most loyal chicken rice following 🍚 Korkai Chicken Rice is a neighbourhood staple on one of Bangkok's most celebrated street food strips, near Chulalongkorn University. Silky poached chicken, aromatic rice, punchy ginger-chili sauce — the kind of honest, well-executed khao mun gai that's built a cult following among students and locals alike. Now with four branches across Bangkok, Monday to Saturday until 11pm. The Banthat Thong original is the one worth queuing for.
description_zh: 班塔通路上最值得排隊的雞飯 🍚 Korkai Chicken Rice 藏在朱拉大學旁的美食街上，白斬雞嫩滑多汁、薑蒜辣醬香氣撲鼻，一盤售價親民，是大學生與在地人下課後固定報到的那間，現開四家分店仍保持原有水準，週一至週六開到晚上十一點。
address: 1636 Banthat Thong Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: Nearly 70 years of Hainanese chicken rice on Charoen Krung Road 🍚 Sui Heng in Yannawa has been run by the same family for three generations, and the recipe hasn't needed changing. Generous portions of silky poached chicken, fragrant rice, and a fermented soybean dipping sauce with the perfect sour-sweet-salty balance. The lime and sour plum soup on the side is the secret weapon — refreshing and deeply satisfying. Open from 6:30am and until 3am — one of Bangkok's most honest chicken rice institutions, any time of day or night.
description_zh: 曼隆路旁傳承近 70 年的三代雞飯老店 🍚 Sui Heng 在 Yannawa 默默耕耘、接待一代又一代老曼谷人，海南式白斬雞份量大、雞油飯香氣撲鼻、發酵豆醬調味汁酸甜鹹三味平衡，招牌酸梅萊姆湯清爽解膩是必點，半夜三點還開著，是深夜覓食最讓人感動的那一碗。
address: 1739 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Yan Nawa, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Old Bangkok's most welcoming chicken rice family shop 🍚 Kao Mun Gai Wannaporn sits on Prachathipatai Road near Wat Intharawihan — a relaxed, family-run spot where the chicken is consistently juicy and tender, the rice is fragrant, and the chili sauce hits exactly the right notes. The English menu is a thoughtful touch, the soup is genuinely good, and the whole meal comes in under 100 baht. The perfect low-key lunch after a morning at the nearby temples.
description_zh: 大皇宮附近最讓人驚喜的家常雞飯 🍚 Kao Mun Gai Wannaporn 藏在 Prachathipatai 路上，嫩滑白斬雞配香濃雞油飯、辣醬恰到好處，湯頭清甜讓人喝完還想再來一碗，老闆一家親切招待，一份不到 100 銖，是逛完金山寺或大皇宮後最讓人放鬆的家庭風小館。
address: 96/14 Prachathipatai Rd, Khwaeng Bang Khun Phrom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Silom's most quietly innovative chicken rice 🍚 Hoong (หุง, meaning "to cook rice") on Phiphat 2 brings a sous vide approach to the Thai classic — chicken cooked low and slow for a tenderness that goes well beyond the usual poached version, served with aromatic chicken-fat rice and house-made sauces. It's built a devoted following among Japanese expats and office workers in the Chong Nonsi area who know a good thing when they find it. The kind of lunch spot you discover once and keep coming back to.
description_zh: 矽隆最有創意的進化系雞飯 🍚 Hoong（หุง，意為「炊煮」）藏在 Phiphat 2 巷，以低溫舒肥技術重新詮釋傳統海南雞飯，雞肉嫩到入口即化、比傳統白斬雞更進一步，雞油飯香氣馥郁，在日本食客之間口碑甚佳，是 Chong Nonsi 附近上班族午餐的私藏秘密。
address: Sathorn Corner, 46 Phiphat 2, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: The morning chicken rice of old Bangkok near Thewet market 🍚 Mongkolchai — whose name means "crown of victory" — has been earning that title on Samsen Road for decades. The chicken is plump and fatted, cooked to an old-school Hainanese standard, the rice is enriched with chicken broth, and the dark fermented soybean sauce with garlic, lime, and chili is the real draw. From 45 baht, open 6am to 2pm daily. The kind of place old Bangkok locals and serious food writers quietly trek across the city for.
description_zh: 泰威河市場旁老曼谷人吃早餐的那間 🍚 Mongkolchai（「勝利之冠」）在三森路默默傳承多年，椰奶燉雞入味滑嫩、雞油飯粒粒飽滿，招牌酸辣醬發酵豆蒜辣萊姆四味平衡，一份 45-55 銖，早上六點開門到下午兩點就結束，是老城區散步時最值得特地繞進去的早晨一碗。
address: 314 Thanon Samsen, Khwaeng Dusit, Khet Dusit, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles • Sam Yan
name_zh: Lek Yai Traditional Tom Yum Noodles • Sam Yan
description_en: Banthat Thong Road's most satisfying bowl of old-school tom yum noodles 🍜 Lek Yai has been perfecting one thing for decades — a broth that's more about tangy citrus complexity than heat, with fresh lime, roasted chili powder, and enough pork or seafood to fill two people. The noodles are soft, the wontons are stuffed with minced pork, and the bowl is generously oversized at around 65 baht. Street-side tables come with the full Bangkok chaos soundtrack — grab one anyway. Open daily from 11am to midnight.
description_zh: 班塔通路上最傳統的酸辣麵湯 🍜 Lek Yai 以招牌番茄酸辣湯底聞名，鮮萊姆、烤辣椒粉香氣層次分明，豬肉丸軟嫩、蝦仁魷魚海鮮版更是鮮美，一碗份量大到讓人驚訝，65 銖起、開到午夜，是逛完 Sam Yan 最值得坐下來吃一碗的老派滋味。
address: 1440 Banthat Thong Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวรสเด็ด กังเลี่ยงเฮง
name_zh: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวรสเด็ด กังเลี่ยงเฮง
description_en: A melt-in-your-mouth braised pork noodle hiding near the Golden Mount 🍜 กังเลี่ยงเฮง is tucked in a tiny shopfront on Boriphat Road, opposite the fire station near Wat Saket. The signature braised pork noodle soup is what regulars come for — black pepper-fragrant broth, pork so tender it dissolves on the tongue without chewing, and thin noodles that soak up every drop. Under 100 baht, cramped but worth it, and the kind of hidden local gem that food hunters quietly keep to themselves.
description_zh: 金山寺旁小巷藏著一碗讓人入口即化的燉豬肉麵 🍜 กังเลี่ยงเฮง 在 Boriphat 路消防站對面的小店面裡，招牌燉豬肉麵湯底以黑胡椒提香、豬肉燉到不用咬直接化開，細麵條吸飽湯汁，一碗百銖以下、空間雖小卻讓人一吃難忘，是逛金山寺附近最值得繞進去找的那碗麵。
address: 34 Boriphat Rd, Khwaeng Ban Bat, Khet Pom Prap Sattru Phai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10100, Thailand

description_en: Khlong San's most beloved pink noodle & coconut ice cream shop 🍜 Je Ju Noodle on Charoen Nakhon Road is a neighbourhood institution — the yen ta fo (pink-sauced noodles) is the signature, loaded with fresh fish balls, crispy pork, and tofu in a tangy, sweet fermented bean broth that earns its reputation. The tom yam noodle broth is equally worth ordering. Finish with their coconut ice cream, a ritual for regulars. A photo menu makes it easy to order, BTS Krung Thon Buri is a 10-minute walk, and the price is firmly in the "why not come back tomorrow" category.
description_zh: คลองสาน 最讓人難忘的粉紅麵與椰子冰淇淋 🍜 Je Ju Noodle 就在昭披耶河旁的 Charoen Nakhon 路上，招牌เย็นตาโฟ（粉紅麵）湯底顏色鮮豔、海鮮魚板配料豐盛，酸甜平衡恰到好處，Tom Yam 麵湯頭清鮮芬芳也不容錯過，結束後再來一球招牌椰子冰淇淋，是 Klook San 在地人家喻戶曉的老字號。
address: 1313 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Bang Lamphu Lang, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Banthat Thong Road's most authentic boat noodles, customisable spice level 🍜 Asawin Boat Noodles on the Sam Yan end of Banthat Thong serves proper Thai boat noodles the traditional way — rich, blood-seasoned broth with pork or beef, fresh ingredients, and your choice of noodles. The spice level is adjustable, the dessert options (cendol in coconut milk, Thai coconut custard) are a worthy finish, and the air-conditioned setting makes it comfortable to linger. Open daily from 11am to midnight.
description_zh: 班塔通路上最正宗的船麵，自由調整辣度 🍜 Asawin Boat Noodles 就在 Sam Yan 附近，牛肉豬肉船麵湯底以豬血提香、濃郁深邃，食材新鮮、麵條選擇多元，還有椰奶沙冰與椰奶布丁畫下甜蜜句點，開到午夜、冷氣舒服，是班塔通路上最讓人踏實坐下來吃上幾碗的船麵館。
address: 989, 991 Banthat Thong Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

name_en: โต๋ว ก๋วยเตี๋ยว : Dhou noodles
name_zh: โต๋ว ก๋วยเตี๋ยว : Dhou noodles
description_en: A comforting bowl of noodles steps from MRT Itsaraphap 🍜 โต๋ว ก๋วยเตี๋ยว on Itsaraphap Road near Wat Arun is known for its springy, chewy thin noodles and a rich nam tok pork broth with good peppery depth — and you can add ma la spice powder if you want more kick. The soup is mellow and well-rounded without being salty. Air-conditioned, open daily until 8pm, and the kind of neighbourhood noodle shop you stumble into near Wat Arun and quietly keep coming back to.
description_zh: MRT อิสรภาพ 出口走幾步就有這碗 🍜 โต๋ว ก๋วยเตี๋ยว 藏在鄭王廟附近的 Itsaraphap 路上，以 Q 彈細米粉為招牌，豬肉水落麵湯底濃郁帶胡椒香，另可加麻辣粉提升層次，湯頭沉穩不死鹹，適合慢慢喝，是逛鄭王廟後那頓讓人放鬆的鄰里家常麵。
address: 260 Thanon Itsaraphap, Khwaeng Wat Arun, Khet Bangkok Yai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

name_en: สมยงตำซั่ว สีลม
name_zh: สมยงตำซั่ว สีลม
description_en: Silom's most beloved Isaan canteen — 20+ years and still packed 🌶️ สมยงตำซั่ว is tucked on Soi Convent 18/1, serving punchy northeastern Thai classics to a loyal crowd of office workers who keep coming back daily. Green papaya salad in every style (Thai, fermented fish, Lao, mango), smoky grilled pork neck, crispy chicken wings, and laab that hits every note — spicy, sour, herbaceous. Dishes from 40–200 baht, open Monday to Saturday 9am–9:30pm. Closed Sundays.
description_zh: 矽隆上班族的秘密伊善食堂，超過 20 年不敗傳奇 🌶️ สมยง 藏在 Soi Convent 18/1，烤豬頸肉焦香嫩滑、各式青木瓜沙拉任你點（ตำไทย、ตำซั่ว、ตำลาว），烤雞翅酥脆多汁、拉布豬肉香辛鮮爽，一份 40-200 銖，週一至週六早九點到晚九點半，是 Sala Daeng 一帶最讓人流連的東北泰菜飯堂。
address: 18 1 Convent Rd, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

name_en: ส้มตำอิหยังวะ
name_zh: ส้มตำอิหยังวะ
description_en: The Isaan restaurant with a name that means "What the heck is this?!" 🌶️ ส้มตำอิหยังวะ lives up to its cheeky name — a bold, high-energy Isaan restaurant in the Ngam Wong Wan area with a papaya salad menu that goes way beyond the basics. The grilled beef shank is the standout (order it as larb or with dipping sauce), the crispy pork belly is generous and satisfying, and the squid with salted egg earns its own fan club. Clean space, friendly service, affordable prices, open until midnight. The kind of local Isaan joint you come back to every week.
description_zh: 「到底是什麼鬼好吃」的伊善料理連鎖店 🌶️ ส้มตำอิหยังวะ 以「แซ่บถึงใจ」（辣到心坎裡）為招牌，青木瓜沙拉選擇多到讓你選不完，烤牛腱肉嫩香入味堪稱招牌，炸豬三層肉外酥內嫩、鹹蛋烤花枝彈牙鮮美，空間乾淨明亮、服務親切有活力，是งามวงศ์วาน 一帶最讓人一吃再來的伊善食堂。
address: 345 31 Soi Ngam Wong Wan 47 Yaek 42, Khwaeng Thung Song Hong, Khet Lak Si, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10210, Thailand

name_en: Jaekoy เจ๊ก้อย ส้มตำอาหารอีสาน เพชรบุรี12 (สาขา1)
name_zh: Jaekoy เจ๊ก้อย ส้มตำอาหารอีสาน เพชรบุรี12 (สาขา1)
description_en: Ratchathewi's most beloved late-night Isaan canteen 🌶️ Jaekoy on Phetchaburi Soi 12 has been drawing loyal crowds for years — a lively, loud, no-frills Isaan restaurant where the papaya salad is generous and punchy, the communal jimjum hotpot is loaded with fresh ingredients, and the fish-sauce-marinated prawns have their own fan club. Tripadvisor ranked, open daily until 3am, and just a short walk from BTS Ratchathewi. The kind of place that gets more fun the later you arrive.
description_zh: 拉差威提最熱鬧的深夜伊善食堂 🌶️ เจ๊ก้อย 在เพชรบุรี 12 巷傳承多年，青木瓜沙拉份量大、各種ยำ沙拉道道扎實，招牌จิ้มจุ่ม大鍋熱湯食材滿滿、魚露醃鮮蝦鮮甜辛辣，Tripadvisor 曼谷前 1100 名、從傍晚坐到凌晨三點，是下班後、夜遊後最讓人滿足的那一頓伊善飯。
address: 362/2-3 ระหว่าง ตึกยุพินอพาร์ทเม้น 14 Soi Phayathai, Khwaeng Thanon Phetchaburi, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Michelin-recognised Isaan dining inside a century-old wooden house in Charoen Krung 🌶️ Baan Somtum has been Bangkok's go-to for authentic northeastern Thai cuisine since 2005, and the Bang Rak branch in OP Gardens is the brand's most atmospheric yet — a two-storey renovated wooden house with an outdoor garden dining area surrounded by ferns and a fountain. Twenty-nine varieties of som tam, including the signature Luang Prabang-style with wide papaya strips and fermented fish, grilled pork shoulder, banana blossom salad, and rare hed pawk mushroom soup. Bib Gourmand, open daily 11am–10pm, ten minutes from BTS Saphan Taksin.
description_zh: Charoen Krung 百年老宅裡的米其林伊善料理 🌶️ Baan Somtum 自 2005 年深耕曼谷，Bangrak 分店落腳 OP Gardens 的兩層樓老木屋，29 種青木瓜沙拉任你點，招牌 Tum Luang Prabang 琅勃拉邦風格寬版木瓜絲是必點，烤豬頸肉、香炸炸雞翼、珍稀菇湯道道用料誠實，花園座位芬芳靜謐，距 BTS Saphan Taksin 步行十分鐘。
address: 4, ร้านบ้านส้มตำ ศูนย์การค้า โอ พี การ์เด้นท์, 6 Soi Rong Phasi, แขวงเจริญกรุง, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

name_en: ตำตำ ต้นตำรับ | สามย่านมิตรทาวน์
name_zh: ตำตำ ต้นตำรับ | สามย่านมิตรทาวน์
description_en: Authentic Isaan comfort food, one minute from MRT Sam Yan 🌶️ ตำตำ ต้นตำรับ is tucked in the B1 level of Samyan Mitrtown — making it one of the most accessible Isaan food stops in central Bangkok. Crisp, punchy papaya salad, satisfying larb moo, and a tom saeb with tender pork ribs that's the perfect antidote to Bangkok's heat. Generous portions, fast service, student-friendly prices, and open from 10am. A reliable everyday favourite in the Chulalongkorn area.
description_zh: MRT Samyan 站直通地下一樓的伊善快食好選擇 🌶️ ตำตำ ต้นตำรับ 藏在 Samyan Mitrtown B1 層，下地鐵走一分鐘就到，青木瓜沙拉酥脆爽辣、拉布豬肉香辛下飯、ต้มแซ่บ豬軟骨湯清爽解膩，菜單豐富份量實在，是朱拉大學一帶學生和上班族最愛的平日午餐首選。
address: ชั้น B1 944 944/1 Thanon Rama IV, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: The mookata that breaks all the old rules — right opposite IconSiam 🍖 HEY Mookrata in the OURS complex on Charoen Nakhon Soi 10 is unlike your average Thai BBQ hotpot — polished interiors, air-con throughout, private dining rooms, and a garden zone that makes every visit feel like a proper evening out. They're the first restaurant in Thailand to serve a "mookata cake" — a layered grilled meat dish that's become a signature alongside imported beef cuts, fresh seafood, and a house dipping sauce that regulars say is the best in Bangkok. Open weekday evenings, all-day weekends. BTS Gold Line Charoen Nakhon station, 400m walk.
description_zh: IconSiam 對面最有型的泰式烤肉火鍋 🍖 HEY Mookrata 坐落 OURS 商場的 Charoen Nakhon 10 巷，是曼谷首家推出「หมูกระทะเค้ก」肉餅鐵板燒的品牌，進口牛肉、新鮮海鮮、招牌特製沾醬皆用心研製，冷氣足、環境美、室內外包廂任選，金線輕軌 BTS Charoen Nakhon 站下車步行 400 公尺，傍晚五點開始、周末午間即可入座。
address: 240, 1 Soi Pho Suwan, Khwaeng Khlong Ton Sai, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

name_en: ติดใจหมูกระทะ เทเวศร์
name_zh: ติดใจหมูกระทะ เทเวศร์
description_en: Old Bangkok's most unpretentious neighbourhood mookata 🐷 ติดใจหมูกระทะ on Samsen Road near the Thewet area is the kind of place locals keep to themselves — affordable Thai BBQ hotpot with quality pork, seafood sets starting at just 189 baht per person, unlimited refills for 35 baht, and a friendly owner who treats every table like a regular. Simple outdoor seating, fan-cooled, with dessert included. Open until midnight — the perfect lazy weeknight dinner near the old city.
description_zh: 大皇宮附近最親民的在地泰式烤肉鍋 🐷 ติดใจหมูกระทะ 就在三森路的德威寺一帶，設備簡單卻乾淨，豬肉新鮮品質好，套餐含海鮮每人 189 銖、飲料 35 銖無限續，老闆娘招待親切、還附甜點，是老城區居民下班後最喜歡叫一鍋的那種地方。
address: 244 Thanon Samsen, Khwaeng Bang Khun Phrom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: หมูกระทะ ไทยเลอ บาร์กริล
name_zh: หมูกระทะ ไทยเลอ บาร์กริล
description_en: A 90s café-style mookata that actually makes you want to linger 🐷🎵 ThailaoS Bar Grill on Chan Road Soi 22 is the laid-back mookata you didn't know you needed — bright vintage decor, 90s Thai music playing softly, and a proper sit-down atmosphere worlds away from the typical loud BBQ spot. Nine dipping sauces including a legendary grandma recipe that's been passed down since 1997, fresh pork, seafood, and sukiyaki options, cold draft beer, and open until midnight. The kind of place you go for one round and end up ordering another beer.
description_zh: 90 年代復古咖啡廳風格的泰式烤肉鍋 🐷🎵 ไทยเลอ บาร์กริล 藏在 Chan Road 22 巷，由 2540 年（1997）阿嬤的傳奇秘方延伸而來，空間明亮復古、播著 90 年代懷舊音樂，9 種沾醬任你選、推薦「阿嬤沾醬」與「鳳梨海鮮醬」，新鮮豬肉、海鮮、蔬菜一應俱全，比起一般嘈雜的烤肉店更有約會或朋友小聚的氣氛，開到深夜、有停車場。
address: Thanon Chan, Khwaeng Thung Wat Don, Khet Sathon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10120, Thailand

description_en: Huai Khwang's most legendary street-side mookata 🐷 Khun Ple Mookata on Soi 20 Mithuna is a Bangkok institution — open-air seating, three house-made dipping sauces that regulars mix together for maximum effect, and sets from 300–500 baht that serious mookata fans from Singapore, Korea, and Japan all rate as among the best in the city. No reservations, walk-in only, and yes — there will be a queue on weekends. Go before 5pm to skip the wait. Opens daily at 4pm, closes 11:30pm.
description_zh: 慧恭最值得排隊的街邊泰式烤肉鍋 🐷 Khun Ple Mookata 藏在 Mithuna 20 巷小院子裡，三款沾醬各有個性、混搭更驚艷，套餐 300-500 銖物超所值，韓國人、新加坡人、泰國在地人都說好，傍晚四點開始、六點前去可以省排隊時間，開到深夜十一點半，MRT 慧恭站步行 15 分鐘。
address: Soi 20 Mithuna, Lane 22, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Khet Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10310, Thailand

name_en: Saneh Mookrata เสน่ห์ หมูกระทะ
name_zh: Saneh Mookrata เสน่ห์ หมูกระทะ
description_en: Sukhumvit 22's most surprising hidden mookata 🐷 Saneh Mookrata is tucked on a quiet stretch of Soi 22 — a clean, modern, air-conditioned space that runs on a 40-year family pork recipe from their own farm. The garlic-pepper marinated pork neck, miso pork collar, and imported Australian beef are the must-orders, paired with three house dipping sauces and proactive staff who refill the soup without being asked. Google 4.9 from nearly 300 reviews, steps from Emsphere, and one of Bangkok's most underrated BBQ spots.
description_zh: 素坤逸 22 巷裡的隱藏版精品烤肉鍋 🐷 Saneh Mookrata 以自家農場豬肉為傲、傳承 40 年秘方，蒜香黑胡椒豬頸肉、味噌豬頸排道道用心，三款沾醬各有風格、服務親切不斷補湯，室內冷氣明亮，Google 4.9 分、Emsphere 步行即達，是素坤逸一帶最讓人驚喜的街頭烤肉小館。
address: 38/9 Sukhumvit Soi 22, Klongtoey, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

name_en: ซอยข่อยแน Soikoinae ส้มตำ อารีย์-สะพานควาย
name_zh: ซอยข่อยแน Soikoinae ส้มตำ อารีย์-สะพานควาย
description_en: Ari's most local Isaan secret 🌶️ ซอยข่อยแน is tucked in a quiet corner of Phahon Yothin Soi 12 — the kind of neighbourhood Isaan spot that locals eat at every week and never tell anyone about. Punchy papaya salad, crying tiger grilled pork skewers, and bold northeastern flavours in a relaxed, no-fuss setting. The name means "this alley" in Thai — fitting for a place that feels like you've been let in on something. Open daily, consistently good, and the best-kept secret in the Ari area for anyone who loves Isaan food done properly.
description_zh: Ari 最隱藏的伊善料理巷弄 🌶️ ซอยข่อยแน藏在 Phahon Yothin 12 巷的安靜角落，「ข่อยแน」取自巷弄特色，每天吃都不膩的青木瓜沙拉、哭泣老虎烤豬肉串道道夠辣夠香，是 Ari 在地人一說出來就讓外人驚訝「這裡有這種地方？」的秘密口袋名單。
address: 436/8 Soi Phahon Yothin 12, Khwaeng Samsen Nai, Khet Phaya Thai, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Hidden inside Thailand's National Stadium — and absolutely worth finding 🌶️ Zaapteamchad is tucked inside the Sports Authority of Thailand stadium on Ramkhamhaeng Road, making it one of Bangkok's most surprisingly located Isaan restaurants. The salted egg papaya salad hits every note — sweet, sour, salty, spicy — the Vietnamese sausage and squid salad combo is the signature, and the chicken feet tom sup is rich and deeply satisfying. A spice level indicator means no unwanted surprises, fast service, affordable prices, and Google 4.6. Bring a group and work through the menu properly.
description_zh: 泰國國家體育場裡的伊善料理秘密據點 🌶️ แซ่บทีมชาติ Zaapteamchad 藏在 กกท 體育場裡、位置意外讓人驚喜，鹹蛋青木瓜沙拉酸甜鹹辣樣樣到位、豬香腸配花枝沙拉是必點，雞腳辣湯軟嫩入味、炸雞皮薄酥脆，辣度指示器讓你自由選擇火力，Google 4.6 分、宴請一群朋友最合適。
address: ร้านอยู่ติดสระว่ายน้ำ สนามราชมังคลากีฬาสถาน การกีฬาแห่งประเทศไทย 286 Ramkhamhaeng Rd, Khwaeng Hua Mak, Khet Bang Kapi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10240, Thailand

description_en: Silom's most convenient Isaan lunch fix 🌶️ Esan Sab on Saladaeng Soi 1 is the neighbourhood Isaan canteen that office workers in the Silom-Sala Daeng corridor quietly rely on — punchy papaya salad, grilled pork neck with sticky rice, and satisfying Isaan soups at prices that make it easy to come back tomorrow. Steps from BTS Sala Daeng, open 11am to 10pm, affordable and unpretentious. The kind of spot that earns its repeat customers one bowl at a time.
description_zh: Sala Daeng BTS 步行可達的在地伊善小食堂 🌶️ Esan Sab 藏在 Saladaeng Soi 1，矽隆辦公室上班族午休的私藏秘密，青木瓜沙拉酸辣夠勁、烤豬頸肉焦香下飯、辣湯清爽解膩，菜單選擇多、價格平實，是矽隆商圈午餐最值得放棄便利商店的伊善食堂。
address: 27 Saladaeng Soi 1, Si Lom, Khet Bang Rak, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10500, Thailand

description_en: Ratchada's most reliably delicious open-air Isaan canteen 🌶️ Zabb One sits right beside MRT Thailand Cultural Centre on Ratchadaphisek Road — fans stirring the warm air, tables packed with locals, and a kitchen that churns out proper northeastern Thai food fast. The som tam is fresh and punchy, the larb moo is herbaceous and well-spiced, the grilled pork neck is tender with crispy fat, and the tom saeb broth is sour-spicy and deeply satisfying. Most dishes run 60–150 baht, the menu has English photos, and portions are generous enough for sharing. Bring a group, order widely, and keep the beer coming.
description_zh: 拉差達路上最讓人汗流浹背的道地伊善食堂 🌶️ Zabb One 就在泰國文化中心 MRT 站旁，開放式空間電扇嗡嗡作響、在地人圍桌大口吃喝，青木瓜沙拉酸辣平衡、拉布豬肉香草氣息十足、烤豬頸肉嫩而焦香、tom saeb 湯頭酸辣沁心，60-150 銖一盤物超所值，菜單附英文名稱與照片，是拉差達一帶最推薦帶朋友聚餐的伊善大食堂。
address: Thanon Ratchadaphisek, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Khet Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

name_en: Democracy Pad Thai || Pad Thai Pra Cha Tip Pa Tai
name_zh: Democracy Pad Thai || Pad Thai Pra Cha Tip Pa Tai
description_en: The pad thai you'll want to come back to every day 🍜 Democracy Pad Thai on Dinso Road near the Democracy Monument is a small, heartfelt family-run spot where the owner cooks everything fresh in front of you — the wok hei is real, the portions are generous, and the prices are honest. More than one visitor came back daily for weeks in a row. The crispy chicken version is a standout, and the family's warmth is half the reason people keep returning. Closed Tuesdays. A gem that deserves every bit of love it gets.
description_zh: 民主紀念碑旁最讓人每天都回頭的手工炒河粉 🍜 Democracy Pad Thai 由親切的老闆娘在你眼前現炒，眼見為憑的鍋氣與羅望子醬香氣讓人聞了就走不動，份量大、價格親切，有旅人住在附近整整八週、每天報到，脆炸雞版本尤其不能錯過，週二公休，來之前記得確認。
address: 17 Dinso Rd, Khwaeng Wat Bowon Niwet, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Hell Breaks Loose — the most dramatic pad thai in Bangkok 🔥 Pad Thai Narok Taek ("Hell Breaks Loose") lives up to its name completely — chef Aom cooks over towering open flames that rise 1.5 metres above the wok, charring the noodles with genuine wok hei that indoor restaurants can't replicate. The tamarind-heavy sauce is more sour than sweet, roasted chili paste adds a proper kick, and fresh shell-on river prawns are the must-order. Served sizzling on a hot plate, rated in Bangkok's top 10 pad thai lists, and just a 5-minute taxi ride from IconSiam. Watching the chef cook is half the experience.
description_zh: 「地獄爆炸」炒河粉，Khlong San 最猛烈的鍋氣 🔥 Pad Thai Narok Taek 意為「地獄崩裂」，主廚 Aom 以熊熊火焰升至一公尺半的明火大鍋炒製，羅望子醬偏酸不過甜、旋轉辣椒醬提辣、鮮蝦肥美鮮嫩，上桌時仍在鐵板上嘶嘶作響，光是看主廚炒菜就值回票價，入榜曼谷最佳炒河粉名單，IconSiam 旁五分鐘車程。
address: 286 Lat Ya Rd, Khwaeng Khlong San, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

name_en: Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu (Dinso Rd)
name_zh: Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu (Dinso Rd)
description_en: Michelin Bib Gourmand pad thai from a Michelin-starred chef 🔥 Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu was opened by Chef Andy Yang — the first Thai chef to earn a Michelin star in New York — and the Dinso Road flagship is where the original award lives. Huge open flames engulf the wok up front while you watch, caramelising all-natural gluten-free rice noodles in tamarind jus. The signature is the charcoal-grilled Berkshire pork loin version — savory and smoky, more depth than sweetness, unlike any pad thai you've had before. A short walk from Khaosan Road and the Democracy Monument. Open daily 10am–7pm.
description_zh: 「穿透火焰」炒河粉，米其林主廚還原最純粹的一盤 🔥 Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu 由曾在紐約摘下米其林一星的主廚 Andy Yang 創立，門口大鍋火焰竄起兩層樓高，自然無麩質米粉以羅望子汁糖焦化煮製，招牌 Berkshire 豬里脊炭烤切片鋪頂，鹹鮮勝於甜、煙燻鍋氣每口都感受得到，連續多年獲米其林 Bib Gourmand，民主紀念碑旁、考山路步行可達。
address: 115/5 Dinso Rd, Khwaeng Wat Bowon Niwet, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most legendary pad thai, certified by a Prime Minister 🍜 Thipsamai has been making pad thai since the 1960s — using Sen Chan noodles from Chantaburi Province, a secret prawn-head oil passed down through three generations, and a charcoal flame that gives every plate its signature depth. The wrapped-in-egg version (Pad Thai Haw Kai) is the must-order: a paper-thin translucent egg blanket enclosing perfectly balanced noodles inside. Michelin Bib Gourmand, right next to Raan Jay Fai, and the freshly squeezed orange juice is almost as famous as the pad thai itself. Come at opening time to beat the queue.
description_zh: 曼谷炒河粉的傳說，從 1966 年炒到今天 🍜 Thipsamai 由泰國總理親自認證為全泰最佳炒河粉，祖傳三代秘方以蝦頭油炒製尖竹汶府 Sen Chan 米線，招牌蛋包炒河粉薄薄一層蛋皮半透明，米其林 Bib Gourmand 加持，現榨柳橙汁是必點，就在 Jay Fai 隔壁、大鐘樓旁，排隊是必要的儀式。
address: 313, 315 Maha Chai Rd, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: Kope Hya Tai Kee Na Saranrom
name_zh: Kope Hya Tai Kee Na Saranrom
description_en: A taste of old Bangkok since 1952, right by the Giant Swing ☕ Kope Hya Tai Kee sits steps from the Giant Swing near Saranrom Park — marble round tables, wooden chairs, ceiling fans, and a menu that hasn't needed reinventing in 70 years. The signature Kai Kra Ta is the must-order: two eggs in a sizzling iron skillet, topped with minced pork and served with a crispy mini baguette. The signature Cafe-Té coffee made with sugarcane juice is smoky, sweet, and deeply satisfying. Ten minutes from MRT Sam Yot, and the perfect way to start any old town morning before the Grand Palace or Thipsamai.
description_zh: 1952 年的老城區早晨就是這個味道 ☕ Kope Hya Tai Kee 就在大鐘樓旁、沙蘭倫宮廣場一角，大理石圓桌、木質老椅、天花板電扇慢慢搖，招牌鐵鍋煎蛋佐豬肉碎醬搭小法棍酥脆下飯，「Cafe-Té」甘蔗汁咖啡入口微甜帶煙燻香氣讓人一口接一口，是逛大皇宮前或 Thipsamai 吃完後最值得坐下來感受老曼谷時光的地方。
address: 13 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Wang Burapha Phirom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

name_en: Kope Hya Tai Kee The Parq Rama 4
name_zh: Kope Hya Tai Kee The Parq Rama 4
description_en: Bangkok's most beloved 70-year-old café, now with air conditioning ☕ Kope Hya Tai Kee brings its iconic 1952 Thai-Chinese breakfast culture to The Parq on Rama 4 — the same sizzling Kai Kra Ta iron-pan eggs, crispy mini baguette, and signature sugarcane Cafe-Té coffee, all in a comfortable air-conditioned mall setting. Steps from MRT Klong Toei. The perfect option when you want the nostalgia without the heat of the original open-air shophouse.
description_zh: 1952 年老城咖啡廳的新據點，現在有冷氣了 ☕ Kope Hya Tai Kee The Parq 分店把 70 年經典帶進 Rama 4 的現代商場，招牌鐵鍋煎蛋、小法棍、甘蔗汁咖啡一樣美味，多了冷氣與舒適座位，MRT Klong Toei 步行即達，是為懷舊早餐找個涼爽落腳處的最佳選擇。
address: Unit-114 88 Thanon Ratchadaphisek, Khwaeng Khlong Toei, Khet Khlong Toei, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10110, Thailand

description_en: The quieter, more atmospheric sibling of Bangkok's most iconic café ☕ Kope Hya Tai Kee on Siri Phong Road is the branch locals recommend over the tourist-heavy Giant Swing location — same marble round tables, wooden chairs, and 70-year recipe, but noticeably calmer and easier to get a seat. The Kai Kra Ta iron-pan eggs with minced pork and crispy baguette are the must-order, the Thai milk tea is rich and perfectly sweet, and the hexagonal light frames and vintage menu illustrations add real character. Ten minutes on foot from MRT Sam Yot, and the most relaxed way to experience old town Bangkok over breakfast.
description_zh: 大鐘樓旁最道地的泰中早餐時光 ☕ Kope Hya Tai Kee Siri Phong 分店比原店更安靜、更好坐，大理石圓桌、木質老椅、六角燈框裝潢保留了 70 年歲月感，鐵鍋煎蛋配豬肉碎醬小法棍香氣四溢，泰式奶茶甜而不膩，MRT Sam Yot 步行 10 分鐘，逛完大皇宮後最值得坐下來感受老城慢時光的地方。
address: Thanon Siri Phong, Khwaeng Samran Rat, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Bangkok's most beloved old-school breakfast café since 1933 ☕ On Lok Yun on Charoen Krung Road is a living piece of old Bangkok — faded Milo tins stacked on the shelves, ceiling fans spinning slowly, and a menu that hasn't needed updating in decades. The coconut kaya custard with soft white bread is the must-order, the French toast is warm and fluffy, and the Thai iced coffee is smoky and deeply satisfying. Open from 5:30am until 3:30pm, steps from Memorial Bridge, and Tripadvisor ranked #678 in Bangkok. Come early on weekends or expect a queue — and just join it, it moves fast.
description_zh: 1933 年開始的老城區早晨傳奇 ☕ On Lok Yun 就在昭披耶河邊的耶裡舊鋪仔街，老舊米勎罐子疊滿架、吊扇緩緩搖轉，椰漿卡士達吐司入口即化、法式吐司每口都是溫暖、炸雞蛋配培根附送免費茶水，泰式冰咖啡煙燻濃郁一喝難忘，TripAdvisor 曼谷前 700 名，早上五點半就開門，是老城最適合慢慢開始一天的地方。
address: 72 ถ. เจริญกรุง Khwaeng Wang Burapha Phirom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Ramkhamhaeng's most welcoming halal breakfast spot ☕ KOH NAI SOI is tucked down a quiet alley off Soi Ramkhamhaeng 8 — a clean, modern café serving a wonderfully eclectic mix of Thai, Chinese, and Western breakfast and brunch, all halal certified. Eggs Benedict, signature roti, pathongko with pandan custard dip, congee, and quality coffee from Americano to caramel macchiato. QR code ordering, food arrives in under five minutes, and the team is genuinely warm. Open from 6am, closed Fridays. The kind of local find that makes your whole neighbourhood feel different.
description_zh: Ramkhamhaeng 巷弄裡最親切的清真早午餐小店 ☕ KOH NAI SOI 藏在 Ramkhamhaeng 8 巷小路裡，泰式中式美式早午餐一次搞定，班尼迪克蛋、炸油條配椰絲卡士達醬、粥品飲料一應俱全，清真認證、使用新鮮食材、QR Code 點餐服務超快，六點開門到下午，週五公休，是住在拉瑪堪恆一帶最值得早起的理由。
address: 37 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 8 Yaek 2, Khwaeng Hua Mak, Khet Bang Kapi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10240, Thailand

name_en: โกปี๊เฮี้ยะไถ่กี่ ณ ประชาธิปไตย ข้างวัดมกุฏฯ
name_zh: โกปี๊เฮี้ยะไถ่กี่ ณ ประชาธิปไตย ข้างวัดมกุฏฯ
description_en: The quietest Kope Hya Tai Kee, by the Democracy Monument ☕ This branch of the beloved 1952 café sits on Prachathipatai Road beside Wat Makut — a less-known outpost that locals prefer precisely because there's no queue. Same marble round tables, same ceiling fans, same iron-pan Kai Kra Ta with crispy baguette, and the same sugarcane Cafe-Té coffee that made the brand famous. The perfect breakfast stop after visiting Wat Saket or the Democracy Monument, without the tourist rush of the Giant Swing original.
description_zh: 民主紀念碑旁最不擁擠的泰中早餐 ☕ โกปี๊เฮี้ยะไถ่กี่ 這個分店藏在 Prachathipatai 路上、Wat Makut 旁安靜角落，比大鐘樓原店更清幽、不用排隊，大理石圓桌、老椅子原汁原味保留，招牌鐵鍋煎蛋配法棍、甘蔗汁咖啡道地滋味，逛完黃金山寺或民主紀念碑後最值得轉進來坐一坐的地方。
address: 110 Prachathipatai Rd, Khwaeng Bang Khun Phrom, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: Phloen Chit's most reliable all-day brunch 🥞 Breakfast Story brings its Canadian-founded brunch philosophy to the 3rd floor of Mahatun Plaza — organic eggs, real maple syrup, eggs Benedict, fluffy pancakes, and bottomless coffee from 7am to 11pm. Steps from BTS Phloen Chit, and the same honest, generous quality that made the Thonglor original a staple. The kind of dependable go-to that every neighbourhood needs.
description_zh: Phloen Chit 最舒適的全天早午餐 🥞 Breakfast Story 把加拿大老闆的招牌早午餐精神帶進 Mahatun Plaza 三樓，有機雞蛋、真楓糖漿、班尼迪克蛋、厚鬆餅道道用心，從早上七點到晚上十一點，BTS Phloen Chit 站步行即達，是 Chidlom 一帶辦公室人員與購物後最舒服的早午餐去處。
address: Mahatun Plaza, 888, 3rd Floor (above Blue Cheri, 34-35 ถนน เพลินจิต แขวงลุมพินี เขตปทุมวัน กรุงเทพมหานคร 10330, Thailand

name_en: ซ้งเตี๋ยวหมูต้มยำมะนาว Zongtiew Tom Yum Noodles
name_zh: ซ้งเตี๋ยวหมูต้มยำมะนาว Zongtiew Tom Yum Noodles
description_en: The tom yum noodle bowl worth crossing the river for 🍜 ซ้งเตี๋ยว on Charoen Nakhon Soi 30/2 has built a loyal following for one thing: a pork tom yum noodle soup made with fresh lime that's bright, sour, and fragrant without any eye-watering sharpness. Silky pork slices, freshly fried pork lard croutons for crunch, and a clean broth that lets every ingredient speak. The space is neat and welcoming, and Grab delivery is available for when the craving hits at home. Not far from IconSiam — a very good reason to linger on the Charoen Nakhon side.
description_zh: IconSiam 旁最讓酸辣控魂牽夢縈的那碗麵 🍜 ซ้งเตี๋ยว 藏在 Charoen Nakhon 30/2 巷，招牌豬肉冬蔭麵湯底以新鮮萊姆提酸、清爽不嗆眼、豬肉切片嫩滑、撒上現炸豬油渣酥脆點睛，空間乾淨整潔、服務親切，絕對值得繞路特地去吃一碗，Grab 也有外送。
address: 912 Charoen Nakhon Rd, Khwaeng Bang Lamphu Lang, Khet Khlong San, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10600, Thailand

description_en: Ratchadaphisek's most addictive old-school tom yum noodles 🍜 เล็กใหญ่ on Vibhavadi Soi 2 has been drawing locals back with a tom yum broth that balances sour, sweet, and spicy in exactly the right proportions — no adjusting needed. Soft pork slices, stuffed wontons, and the option to order dry (no soup) make it versatile. Thousands of five-star Grab reviews, open daily until midnight, and one of those bowls that stays in your memory long after leaving Bangkok.
description_zh: 拉差達路旁最讓人念念不忘的古早味冬蔭麵 🍜 เล็กใหญ่ 古早冬蔭豬肉麵藏在 Vibhavadi 2 巷，湯頭酸甜辣三味平衡一絕、豬肉片嫩而入味、餛飩皮薄餡飽、還可加選乾麵版本，Grab 外送評論破千，是 Din Daeng 一帶上班族和學生最常回頭的那一碗，從早到深夜都開著。
address: 126/13 ซ. วิภาวดิรังสิต2 แยก 6 Ratchadaphisek, Khet Din Daeng, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Banthat Thong's most sought-after pork tom yum noodle bowl 🍜 เล้งเตี๋ยว on Banthat Thong Road has built a reputation for a clean, punchy pork tom yum broth — sour without being sharp, spicy without being overwhelming, and loaded with tender pork and plump wontons. The mama hotpot version turns up the heat for those who want it. Thousands of glowing Grab reviews, popular with both Thai locals and Chinese visitors who know it as "冬陰功面," and open late into the night. One of the more reliable bowls on an already great street.
description_zh: 班塔通路上最讓豬肉麵控欲罷不能的一碗 🍜 เล้งเตี๋ยว 藏在班塔通路 1402 號，豬肉冬蔭麵以中文「冬陰功面」廣受中國遊客追捧，湯底酸辣清爽、豬肉鮮嫩、餛飩皮薄餡飽，Mama 熱鍋版本辣勁更足，深夜開著等你，是連 Grab 外送也破千好評的班塔通路隱藏名碗。
address: 1402 Banthat Thong Rd, Khwaeng Wang Mai, Pathum Wan, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10330, Thailand

description_en: The tom yum goong Mark Wiens called mind-blowing 🦐 Tom Yum Goong Banglamphu on Soi Kraisi is just two streets from Khao San Road — a humble street-side stall with no English menu, no sign, and no air conditioning, but arguably the best tom yum goong in Bangkok. The broth is made from scratch using galangal, lemongrass, kaffir lime, and Thai chilies, then fired up to order with massive freshwater river prawns. All that thick, creamy, butteriness in the soup? Pure shrimp head fat — no evaporated milk shortcuts. 30+ years of family cooking, open 9am–6:30pm daily. Point at what the locals are eating and you won't go wrong.
description_zh: Mark Wiens 都說這是他吃過最好的冬蔭功 🦐 Tom Yum Goong Banglamphu 藏在考山路兩個路口外的 Soi Kraisi，沒有菜單、沒有英文招牌，大鍋湯底以檸檬香茅、南薑、泰國辣椒熬製，以新鮮河蝦現炒，蝦腦油讓湯底濃郁奶香讓人停不下來，30 年家族傳承、早上九點開到傍晚六點半，無座無空調、只有真正的街頭靈魂。
address: ที่อยู่ Banglampuh กรุงเทพมหานคร TH หน้าอาคารจอดรถ Soi Kraisi, Khwaeng Talat Yot, Khet Phra Nakhon, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10200, Thailand

description_en: A Nakhon Pathom family recipe, now feeding Huai Khwang's faithful 🍜 เปลว ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำโบราณ brings an old-school Nakhon Pathom-style pork tom yum noodle soup to Bangkok — a slightly sweet-leaning broth with roasted peanuts, generous hand-pressed minced pork patties thick enough to be a meal on their own, and all the toppings you'd hope for in a proper bowl. From 45 baht, Michelin Bib Gourmand recognised, and the evening queue is entirely warranted. One of Huai Khwang's most reliable and satisfying noodle shops.
description_zh: 來自那空帕儂的古早冬蔭麵秘方，落地慧恭 🍜 เปลว ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำโบราณ 以那空帕儂傳統配方聞名，招牌豬肉冬蔭麵湯底帶花生甜香、大塊手打豬肉片鋪頂、份量大得驚人，45 銖起物超所值，傍晚人龍大排長龍是日常，米其林 Bib Gourmand 加持，曼谷總店也在 Huai Khwang 服務在地人。
address: 633 Soi Pracha Rat Bamphen 21, Khwaeng Huai Khwang, Khet Huai Khwang, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10310, Thailand

name_en: Pe Aor Tom Yum Kung Noodle
name_zh: Pe Aor Tom Yum Kung Noodle
description_en: Pe Aor Tom Yum Kung Noodle is tucked down Phetchaburi Soi 5, featured by Luke Nguyen on Street Food Asia, and plastered with celebrity photos from the Thai stars who've been coming for decades. The broth — rich with shrimp head fat, lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime — is what food obsessives travel across Bangkok for. Over 20 variations of tom yum with seafood from 199 baht, up to a legendary 1,500-baht giant lobster bowl that feeds a group. Google 4.9 from 3,670+ reviews. Five-minute walk from BTS Ratchathewi, closed Mondays, and worth every step down the soi.
description_zh: Pe Aor 藏在 Phetchaburi Soi 5 巷弄裡，Luke Nguyen「亞洲街頭美食」節目力推、明星名人照片貼滿牆，招牌蝦頭油奶香濃冬蔭功麵每口都是爆發力，20 款海鮮選項任你挑，巨型龍蝦冬蔭功套餐四人吃不完，BTS Ratchathewi 步行 5 分鐘，週一公休，平日下午來不用等。
address: 68, 51 Thanon Phetchaburi, Khwaeng Thung Phaya Thai, Khet Ratchathewi, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10400, Thailand

description_en: Lat Phrao's most lovingly run Thai noodle restaurant 🍜 Baan Sen Sai on Nak Niwat Road was born out of 40 years of food obsession and a mission to serve premium-ingredient Thai noodles with the hospitality of a top restaurant. Google 5.0 from over 7,600 reviews — a number that speaks for itself. The wagyu beef tom yum noodle soup is the standout, with a broth that's perfectly sour and savoury without needing adjusting. The crispy pork with chili and salt over duck-egg rice is equally worth the trip. Clean, modern, artsy, and genuinely run with care. Open daily 10am–9pm.
description_zh: Lat Phrao最用心的精品泰式麵食小館 🍜 Baan Sen Sai 由走遍泰國四十年的美食人創立，Google 5.0 滿分、7600 則評價令人驚嘆，招牌和牛切片冬蔭麵湯底酸甜平衡、乾式冬蔭麵醬汁濃郁，炸雞蛋餃子、脆豬炒椒鹽飯配鴨蛋道道有料，空間明亮整潔有藝術感，是 Nak Niwat 路上最值得出發前來的麵店。
address: 93, 3 Thanon Nak Niwat, Khwaeng Lat Phrao, Khet Lat Phrao, Krung Thep Maha Nakhon 10230, Thailand
